Entries.Title: The Midnight Romance in Hagwon
Entries.Description: Famous star instructor Seo Hye-jin works until midnight at the academy like any other day. As she stares at the Hall of Fame in the lobby, Joon-ho's name catches her eye. He is one of her proud boast as she did her best to teach him, and he made it into a prestigious university. At the same time, Joon-ho decides to resign from his company and make a new beginning as a rookie instructor.

Episodes.Title: The Hall of Fame
Episodes.Description: Famous star instructor Seo Hye-jin works until midnight at the academy like any other day. As she stares at the Hall of Fame in the lobby, Joon-ho's name catches her eye. He is one of her proud boast as she did her best to teach him, and he made it into a prestigious university. At the same time, Joon-ho decides to resign from his company and make a new beginning as a rookie instructor.

Episodes.Title: The Test Lecture
Episodes.Description: Even though Hye-jin tries to dissuade Joon-ho, he already passed the first written exam and is getting ready for the test lecture. Therefore, Hye-jin privately asks Ji-seok to disapprove of him. Meanwhile, Sang-sub, the Korean language teacher at Chanyoung High, makes a declaration that creates huge confusion among the students and academies.

Episodes.Title: A Teacher And Student Sally Forth
Episodes.Description: A clandestine endeavour dubbed "Teacher and Student Sally Forth" sparks a covert tutoring session led solely by Hye-jin for Joon-ho. Alone in an office after hours, they exchange determined gazes as they delve into a specialized lesson. Meanwhile, the renowned Director Choi, also known as the White Haired Witch, sets her sights on expanding her academy.

Episodes.Title: One-On-One Lecture
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin and Joon-ho's optimism for their collaborative lecture fades as they discover only one student has attended their free session. Shocked, Hye-jin collapses emotionally while Joon-ho supports her in regaining composure. They soon learn of a tactic by Choi Sun Academy to dissuade students from considering switching, but the lone attendee might just potentially change the game.

Episodes.Title: The Changes
Episodes.Description: Director Choi Hyung-sun, the White Haired Witch, finds out that Hye-jin and Joon-ho taught the class even though there was only one student. She checks on Si-woo to see if he wants to switch academies and asks about the lecture. After hearing about the lecture, she calls Hye-jin to meet up. Meanwhile, Joon-ho asks Hye-jin not to leave the academy and stay with him for at least a year.

Episodes.Title: The New Class
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho finds out that Hye-jin has been helping him out by taking a loss. He tells her that he'll work on his own, and Hye-jin gets strange feelings from his attitude. Meanwhile, the new class opens, and Director Kim gets in an awkward position because his plan to demote Hye-jin fails. He feels worried about Hye-jin leaving the academy. He calls Hye-jin out to talk about it. And Joon-ho tags along with her.

Episodes.Title: I Just Confessed My Feelings to You
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho confesses his feelings for Hye-jin and he wants to know what she thinks about him. However, an unexpected visit takes his chance away. Joon-ho wants to talk about it the next day, but Hye-jin has to go and see the director who got hungover. Hye-jin decides to leave the academy and move to Choisun. But after running into Si-woo, she remembers something that she had forgotten about.

Episodes.Title: Can You Not Fall For Joon-ho?
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin tells the director that she won’t leave the academy and teach the Heewon High class. Hye-jin goes to So Young’s office and talks about her decision and what she thinks about Joon-ho with her. After having some beer, she finally confronts her true feelings. Joon-ho comes to take her home, and the two finally confirm their feelings toward each other.

Episodes.Title: Why Have You Come to See Me?
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin and Joon-ho become more intimate, and the two enjoy dating in secret at the academy. The exams are over, and the teachers are busy checking the results of the students. Si-woo comes to the academy and talks about his concerns. Joon-ho becomes more determined to help Si-woo get good grades in Korean. Meanwhile, an unexpected visitor comes to see Hye-jin.

Episodes.Title: A New Instructor
Episodes.Description: Pyo Sang-seob tells Hye-jin that he will be teaching at Choisun Academy. He tells her that the mid-term incident made him think about being a teacher, and it led to quitting his job and starting a new career. Hye-jin is shocked to hear the news though she had an argument with him, she still had respect for him. Meanwhile, Joon-ho doesn’t have a clue why Hye-jin feels complicated about Sang-seob.

Episodes.Title: A New Class
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho’s parents meddle in his work and try to help him become successful in their ways, but Joon-ho feels uncomfortable about it. Seung-hui feels threatened by Hye-jin who is getting all the support from the director. She meets up with Hyung-sun to talk about their future. Meanwhile, Jun-ho wants to open a class that teaches how to read to the students. However, Hye-jin finds it too idealistic.

Episodes.Title: Hye-jin’s Future
Episodes.Description: Sang-seob tells Hye-jin that someone copied her teaching material to use it against her. Joon-ho and Hye-jin’s argument continues, and it gives Sang-seob food for thought. Hye-jin decides to support Joon-ho, but the academy doesn’t approve of opening a new class. Meanwhile, Seung-hui invites Hye-jin to dinner to talk about their future together.

Episodes.Title: Scandal
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin decides to give up her teaching materials and turn down the vice-director’s offer to leave the academy with her. However, Hyung-sun reveals Hye-jin and Joon-ho’s relationship, and Seung-hui decides to use it to her advantage. Meanwhile, one of the instructors who found out about Hye-jin and Joon-ho gathers a meeting to talk about the spreading rumors.

Episodes.Title: Love Me
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin and Joon-ho decide to face the situation with no lies, but they are worried and feel sorry for the people who will be harmed because of them. The other instructors are complaining about the possible privileges that Joon-ho might have earned from Hye-jin. The rumors spread to the students and parents, and it damaged Hye-jin’s reputation. To save the academy from falling apart, Hyun-tak suggests Joon-ho leave the academy.

Episodes.Title: Joon-ho’s Plan
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho talks about how frustrated he was when he realised that there was nothing he could do to help Hye-jin. Hyun-tak is worried about managing the academy as students are leaving after Hye-jin and Joon-ho’s scandal. Seung-hui meets up with other instructors to have them on her side, and Joon-ho decides to face Seung-hui himself to solve the matter.

Episodes.Title: I’ll Give You Everything You Want
Episodes.Description: Some instructors leave the academy, and some request to meet Hyun-tak to talk about their plans. Seung-hui reaches out to Min-jin and asks her to be her spy in Choi-sun and betray Hye-jin. After discovering what Seung-hui did, Hye-jin decides to face the one behind all the schemes around her. As she goes through the struggles, she thinks about what she really wants to do.

Episodes.Title: When Life Tells You to Slow Down
Episodes.Description: During an emergency, Da-eun sees another side of Dr. Dong Go-yun. Senior nurse Park Soo-yeon relates to a patient juggling motherhood and work.

Episodes.Title: A Day in the Life of a Mage
Episodes.Description: Facing monetary issues, Deul-re distances herself from Yeo-hwan. Da-eun grows concerned about a discharged patient reintegrating into his daily life.

Episodes.Title: The Left Behind
Episodes.Description: Da-eun's friends and colleagues worry for her after a tragedy while the doctors, nurses and patients learn about treating PTSD.

Episodes.Title: Expiration Date on Grief
Episodes.Description: Finding it hard to heal without slowing down, Da-eun tries to face her emotions. Yeo-hwan and Go-yun commiserate over their relationship issues.

Episodes.Title: I'm a Nurse With Depression
Episodes.Description: Deul-re deals with her mother’s return. Da-eun finds herself in her patients’ shoes as she grapples with her own diagnosis.

Episodes.Title: The Hardest Part of a Journey
Episodes.Description: Da-eun learns how to prioritize herself, but faces fears of returning to work — until she receives empathetic words of courage from the head nurse.

Episodes.Title: And The Journey Continues
Episodes.Description: Now the subject of office gossip, Da-eun returns to work. During a night out with friends, Deul-re rediscovers what makes her happy.

Episodes.Title: Daily Dose of Sunshine

Entries.Title: Night Has Come
Entries.Description: When class 2-3 arrives at a retreat center, the rest of the classes are nowhere to be found. Their homeroom teacher goes out to look for the missing classes, and they are left alone in the building. Meanwhile, Yoon-seo and all of her classmates get a message out of the blue. With the rules of the game, each one of them receives a role, and the game begins.

Episodes.Title: Field Trip
Episodes.Description: When class 2-3 arrives at a retreat center, the rest of the classes are nowhere to be found. Their homeroom teacher goes out to look for the missing classes, and they are left alone in the building. Meanwhile, Yoon-seo and all of her classmates get a message out of the blue. With the rules of the game, each one of them receives a role, and the game begins.

Episodes.Title: Figuring Out the Rules
Episodes.Description: As morning dawns, the kids try to figure out what this game is actually about. They realize that they can’t leave the boundary indicated in a white line all around the retreat center. Some kids try going up the trail to see if there’s a break in the line. However, things only seem to get worse as they start testing the rules and doubting each other more and more.

Episodes.Title: Rifts Begin to Appear
Episodes.Description: The kids feel guilty and sad about the ones who have died, and this pushes them to drift apart and blame one another. Kyung-jun, the class bully, continues to pick on others and use them to test the rules of the game. Meanwhile, Class President Jun-hee has an idea to refuse to vote for anyone in the game that night.

Episodes.Title: A Frenzied Bloodbath
Episodes.Description: As Jun-hee’s plans to refuse to vote backfires, a bloodbath sweeps the assembly hall. The remaining kids are as divided as ever in the aftermath of losing so many kids in one night. Meanwhile, Yoon-seo is suspicious of the visions she keeps having. She decides to scope out the mysterious tunnel that she found.

Episodes.Title: The Photo Book
Episodes.Description: Woo-ram, the one with the highest votes so far, is about to lose his mind out of fear, and Kyung-jun, the one with the second highest votes, tries to take him down before midnight. Meanwhile, Yoon-seo is stuck on the second floor and finds a photo of the girl she saw in her dream.

Episodes.Title: Yoon-seo and Jun-hee
Episodes.Description: Kyung-jun tries to control the rest of the survivors after he catches the second Mafia. He wants to get back at Jun-hee and the rest who voted for him instead of Woo-ram. Furthermore, Kyung-jun and his friends start to suspect Yoon-seo, who knows where to check the security camera footage.

Episodes.Title: Find the Host
Episodes.Description: Seung-bin is the next target who gets killed by the Mafia overnight. The survivors find him dead on the floor, and one of his friends is washing the bloody clothes in the toilet. Meanwhile, Yu-jun witnesses Kyung-jun and Jin-ha walking out of the building.

Episodes.Title: No One Can Be Trusted
Episodes.Description: Uncovering yet another fatality, the students find themselves gripped by an encroaching sense of fear, with death looming ever closer. The distinction between Mafia and non-Mafia individuals now appears inconsequential, intensifying their apprehension. As a footprint and a message left on a wall emerge, the list of potential targets is narrowed down to two, heightening the emotional tension just before another vote is about to take place.

Episodes.Title: Two Citizens Down
Episodes.Description: The deaths of Jin-ha and Kyung-jun, both innocent Citizens, heighten the students' sense of entrapment. The prevailing unease about the unreliability of seemingly plausible information forces them to prioritize unmasking the Mafia swiftly for their own survival. Meanwhile, So-mi, for some reason, begins to cast doubt on Na-hee, setting the stage for a sudden turn of events.

Episodes.Title: One Mafia Down
Episodes.Description: With Na-hee exposing her identity, everyone discovers that So-mi's the Mafia, placing Na-hee in danger with her police role now known. Holding herself responsible for her friends' deaths, Na-hee devises a plan to unveil the Mafia even after her potential death. Although clues surface, they are too ambiguous to conclusively identify the Mafia. Meanwhile, the focus shifts to Mi-na as the next target in the voting process.

Episodes.Title: The Last Mafia
Episodes.Description: Everyone corners Yeon-woo as the Mafia because he got wounded. He tries to defend himself, but he gets voted in the end. Da-bum feels relieved, and Jun-hee catches that moment. He confronts Da-bum and tells him not to kill Yoon-seo and Jung-won. Yeon-woo’s identity is revealed, and Yoon-seo finds out who the last Mafia is. Meanwhile, Da-bum wants to end the game to avoid being suspected.

Episodes.Title: The End
Episodes.Description: The Mafia Game nears its conclusion as more classmates are executed. Da-bum continues to threaten the remaining students’ lives. Meanwhile, Jung-won faces a dilemma with her life at stake.

Entries.Title: The Heavenly Idol
Entries.Description: Pontifex Lembrary, with his highest authority as a chief, manages all things under Lord Redrin's influence. One day, in the midst of a divine ceremony, Lembrary loses consciousness when The Evil One threatens his and his people's very existence. He then wakes up to find himself in a different world where everyone calls him "Woo Yeon-woo," one of the members of Wild Animal. Everything he does is going to cause major problems.

Episodes.Title: Pontifex Rembrary on Earth
Episodes.Description: Pontifex Lembrary, with his highest authority as a chief, manages all things under Lord Redrin's influence. One day, in the midst of a divine ceremony, Lembrary loses consciousness when The Evil One threatens his and his people's very existence. He then wakes up to find himself in a different world where everyone calls him "Woo Yeon-woo," one of the members of Wild Animal. Everything he does is going to cause major problems.

Episodes.Title: A Slave Contract
Episodes.Description: Lembrary learns that he needs to become a successful idol in order to get endless access to "tributes." He realizes that he needs those tributes to gain energy for prayer. He has a hard time adjusting to the life of an idol, but he manages to get his name known. Meanwhile, Dal gets a job at LLL Entertainment as Wild Animal's road manager. One day, she takes Lembrary to a psychiatrist.

Episodes.Title: Rembrary Becomes Woo Yeon Woo
Episodes.Description: Rembrary has no choice but to embrace the reality of living as Woo Yeon Woo. He participates in "Sing Survival" and surprises everyone with a remarkable performance. However, the judges' decision doesn't match the audience's opinion. Adding to his troubles, he has to team up with an unlikely competitor for an upcoming performance. Despite his efforts, Rembrary struggles to make things work in his favor.

Episodes.Title: The Evil One’s Emergence
Episodes.Description: Woo Sil’s voice suddenly doesn’t come out when he’s up on the stage. Rembrary realizes that it was The Evil One’s doing. Later, Rembrary finds out that Yeon Woo was involved with a religious group called Hongwoodaedae, and he tries to figure out what the group does. Meanwhile, dating rumours about a member of Wild Animal break out.

Episodes.Title: Those With Woo Yeon Woo Shall Be Healed
Episodes.Description: After Rembrary's performance on Sing Survival, people started complimenting him, and it went viral. But with fame comes a price, and a rumor begins to spread. To protect Rembrary's true identity, Dal takes measures to keep it hidden. Meanwhile, Rembrary decides to audition for a project with Maeng Woo Sin as the lead, but he falls into Jo Woon's trap.

Episodes.Title: If We Were Born In The Same World
Episodes.Description: Yeon Woo gets involved with Ms. Ma who embezzled the company’s funds, and his public image worsens. However, Dal manages to change the public opinion by revealing the text Yeon Woo exchanged with Ms. Ma. Meanwhile, Dal talks about Liz Ri to Yeon Woo.

Episodes.Title: How to Reject a Girl Nicely
Episodes.Description: Despite Lembrary's attempt to maintain a distance from Dal, navigating their relationship proves to be difficult. Meanwhile, Dal discovers a distressing truth about Woo Yeon-woo, and Lembrary's words of comfort fail to console her. Upon encountering Oh Jung-sin once more, Lembrary becomes entangled in a predicament stemming from a minor contract between the two.

Episodes.Title: Five Putrid Goblins
Episodes.Description: Lembrary learns something shocking in the Afterlife about Hongwoodaedae. Lembrary goes on a dating variety show after he gets offered a chance to meet Lord Redrin if he captures five goblins. Meanwhile, Dal causes an unexpected situation while under the black magic spell of the Evil One.

Episodes.Title: Dal's Blessing
Episodes.Description: Unlike ever before, Lembrary gets touched by Dal's confession. However, he makes up his mind. Meanwhile, the picture of Lembrary and Dal together comes to light and becomes a huge love scandal that hits Wild Animal hard. Dal makes a big decision to protect Lembrary.

Episodes.Title: The Well of Oblivion
Episodes.Description: Lembrary becomes a criminal overnight. As the people ruthlessly criticize and condemn him, Lembrary becomes frustrated. Dal searches for the CEO of Hong-rin to resolve the Hong-rin crisis, but he is nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Lembrary visits Dal to convince her to run away and be safe.

Episodes.Title: Won't you Regret It?
Episodes.Description: Wild Animal gets invited to the awards, but they have to do a collaboration performance with the Evil Boys. While Rembrary tries to stop the Evil Boys from getting an award, he suddenly learns of the truth. Meanwhile, Jeong-seo gets invited to join Hongwoodaedae.

Episodes.Title: One Drawback
Episodes.Description: Lembrary returns to the world after hearing from Her Majesty how to stop Lord Redrin. However, for Lembrary to stop Lord Redrin, he must make an immense sacrifice which he reconsiders. Meanwhile, Lembrary exposes Woo Yeon-woo's imposter and learns more of Lord Redrin's evil doings.

Episodes.Description: Amid a budding love triangle, Sin-yu struggles to remember what happened with Hong-jo. A much-awaited reversal spell doesn't go as planned.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The love triangle intensifies as Sin-yu and Kwon Jae-gyeong vie for Hong-jo's attention. An unexpected person begins to make Hong-jo uncomfortable.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Hong-jo decides to put up boundaries with Sin-yu. But after she encounters an unsettling situation, he comes to her aid.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: While Hong-jo and Sin-yu both experience illnesses, a sinister plot forms in the dark. Later, they share a tender moment of connection, present and past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Sin-yu makes a decision after remembering his past, making things harder for Hong-jo. As everything falls into place, an evil plot goes into effect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Hong-jo and Sin-yu grow closer, news of their relationship spreads. But as unsavory information circulates in the midst, Hong-jo navigates a minefield.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hong-jo experiences a vision after Sin-yu rescues her from a dangerous situation. Hong-jo discovers the true reason behind Sin-yu's worsening symptoms.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Upon realizing the truth about their history, Hong-jo takes distance from Sin-yu — until a frightening incident brings him closer to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: As Hong-jo navigates a devastating situation, her past life with Sin-yu comes to light. But just as the worst seems to be over, a threat remains.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Even with their relationship solidified, Hong-jo and Sin-yu meet resistance from his father. Hong-jo confronts Yoon Na-yeon about their past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Clued in on her next threat, Hong-jo goes head-to-head with her stalker. Hong-jo and Sin-yu make a momentous decision about their future.

Entries.Title: Bitter Sweet Hell
Entries.Description: In the glittering facade of Young-won's world, envy festers around her flawless career and family life. But a chance encounter with a mysterious client during a counseling session leaves behind an unsettling residue of emotions. From that moment on, her reality unravels like a tapestry in a tempest, mirroring the heart-wrenching abandonment she experienced in her youth when her father chose to end his own life. Or so she believed.

Episodes.Title: The Pigeon House
Episodes.Description: In the glittering facade of Young-won's world, envy festers around her flawless career and family life. But a chance encounter with a mysterious client during a counseling session leaves behind an unsettling residue of emotions. From that moment on, her reality unravels like a tapestry in a tempest, mirroring the heart-wrenching abandonment she experienced in her youth when her father chose to end his own life. Or so she believed.

Episodes.Title: A Downright Lie
Episodes.Description: Young-won senses a web of deception woven by her supposedly trusted family. This realization ignites a spark of suspicion, compelling her to uncover the truth behind her father's death. Rumors swirl, hinting that her father-in-law's demise mirrors a tale from her mother-in-law's novel. As these whispers grow louder, cracks begin to fracture Young-won's once polished facade.

Episodes.Title: Ghost Lights
Episodes.Description: Young-won and Sa-kang shift Ji-eun to Honghak Hospital, which is just a stone's throw from their vacation home. Together, they brainstorm every conceivable scenario of what could've befallen Ji-eun and Jae-jin. While Young-won harbours suspicions about her mother-in-law due to the odd occurrences of late, she deems it crucial to join forces with her to locate Jae-jin first.

Episodes.Title: Mutual Assistance
Episodes.Description: Although Young-won is unhappy about Sa-kang concealing his affair from her, they prioritize gathering clues to find Jae-jin. Following these leads, they eventually arrive at Yokji Island. Shortly after getting there, they hear about a submerged car being found in the sea. Sa-kang immediately questions whether it's the vehicle her son rented.

Episodes.Title: A Trap
Episodes.Description: Young-won empathizes with Jae-jin, coming to terms with his passing. However, Sa-kang struggles to accept the reality of her son's demise, pushing for an ongoing search. Eventually, news of Jae-jin’s incident spread, fueling rumours linking the missing person to Young-won’s family. As a crowd of reporters converges outside her house, her remaining family grapples with another crisis.

Episodes.Title: Is Your Family Well?
Episodes.Description: Young-won and Sa-kang question what Se-na’s motives could have been for approaching Jae-jin. Sa-kang believes Se-na was targeting her, but Young-won thinks otherwise. Meanwhile, filled with more hatred toward Jae-jin than ever, Young-won shifts her focus to protecting her son. The pieces of the puzzle begin to fall into place, revealing the essence of Jae-jin’s disappearance, but Young-won’s anxiety only grows.

Episodes.Title: A Sweet Hell
Episodes.Description: Jae-jin's return home leads Young-won to question why Se-na chose to send him back. Young-won initiates a deeper investigation into Se-na's identity. Meanwhile, Sa-kang is pleased that her son has returned. Jae-jin then gathers the family in the dining room and unveils the family's secrets one by one.

Episodes.Title: The Swamp Of Motherly Love
Episodes.Description: Young-won is solely focused on her son, Sa-kang is always thinking about what's best for her son, and Ji-eun is determined not to lose Jae-jin. With all these obsessions under one roof, Young-won's family begins to fall further apart. Adding to the turmoil, So-yi visits Young-won, revealing she is pregnant with Do-hyun's baby. Young-won realises it's time to confront Se-na directly to protect what's left of her family before it’s too late.

Episodes.Title: Witch Hunt
Episodes.Description: After watching Young-won's threatening message, Se-na appears at the broadcast station. Filled with rage, she grabs Young-won by the neck in a manner suggesting an attempt to harm her. Fortunately, the police arrive just in time to rescue Young-won and arrest Se-na. Young-won subsequently searches for evidence to prove Se-na's crimes and ensure she remains in custody, but it proves to be a challenging task.

Episodes.Title: Gone Night
Episodes.Description: Sa-kang gets framed for killing An Yo-sub. Based on the evidence found at the scene, it is difficult for Sa-kang to avoid the charge. Jae-jin reveals to Young-won that he thinks Tae-oh approached him intentionally. Young-won finds out that Tae-oh is using a fake name and that he is actually Oh Tae-hwan, the older twin brother of Oh Ji-hwan.

Episodes.Title: Small Embers Everywhere
Episodes.Description: It turns out Se-na killed Yo-sub to frame Young-won for murder. However, Tae-oh meddled in to put the blame on Sa-kang. Young-won lures Tae-oh into her house, and he gets caught in the end. Tae-oh blames Young-won for destroying his family. Meanwhile, Se-na approaches Ji-eun and convinces her to expose Jae-jin’s family's secrets.

Episodes.Title: Almost Ordinary Family
Episodes.Description: While Young-won holds a press conference, Sa-kang visits Tae-oh in prison and makes him confess that it was Se-na who killed Yo-sub. Se-na kidnaps Do-hyun to lure Young-won to the vacation home. Jae-jin confesses that Ji-eun performed ghost surgery for him and gives up his license. Meanwhile, Sa-kang decides to leave the family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After trashing the fixed fight, a slip up from Mignon puts Oh Young's life, as well as his own, in mortal danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Mignon warns Oh Young of imminent danger and makes a desperate proposition. Oh Young receives help from an unlikely ally.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: In a moment of agonizing desperation, Oh Young-One makes a decision that will forever change the course of Mignon's life - and his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Mignon and Oh Young find themselves at odds with their new living arrangements.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Mignon and Oh Young adjust to their new lives.

Episodes.Title: Bait

Episodes.Title: Marginal Man
Episodes.Description: As Ho-jae's enemy threatens to hurt those closest to him, he risks everything to protect them. Will he survive the ferocious beasts and save Chae-ok?

Episodes.Title: Am I Wrong..?
Episodes.Description: 6 boys who already have a strong bond, and Hwan, an outsider who just arrived in Songju. One misunderstanding leads to a conflict between Hwan and the other boys. In the end, Hwan realizes that his prejudice was the problem, not the boys.

Episodes.Title: Mama
Episodes.Description: The boys begin to clear up their misunderstandings and understand each other's pain. They become closer than family as they prepare a birthday party for Cein, who has always been alone.

Episodes.Title: Lie
Episodes.Description: The boys rely on each other more than their families, more than anyone else. However, some secrets they bury in their own hearts become lies and secret wounds.

Episodes.Title: Anpanman
Episodes.Description: They barely manage to live their own lives, yet they become superheroes when they have to protect each other. But they don't have any flashy gadgets like Batman or powers like Superman.he boys begin to clear up their misunderstandings and understand each other's pain. They become closer than family as they prepare a birthday party for Cein, who has always been alone.

Episodes.Title: Mikrocosmos
Episodes.Description: They become each other's earth, the only place they can live and breathe. An insignificant microcosmos covered with scars, but they still keep dreaming in their own little world.

Episodes.Title: Cetomimidae
Episodes.Description: Just as fish of the same species evolve into different forms under the influence of their environment, the boys have grown into their own personalities over the past half year, for better or worse…

Episodes.Title: Man In The Mirror
Episodes.Description: They become each other's mirrors, which allows them to realize their own pain even more clearly. They have no idea that their own pain will hurt the others like broken shards of a mirror.

Episodes.Title: 13th Apostle
Episodes.Description: The boys confess their secrets to each other in the same way they would to a Catholic priest. Strange confessions from young boys who have no sins to atone for, just like how people sacrifice only the purest lambs.

Episodes.Title: Asteroid 2019 OK
Episodes.Description: Huge dangers that are so close yet go unnoticed. Like the asteroid in 2019 that flashed by us without anyone noticing.

Episodes.Title: Hide And Seek
Episodes.Description: The trauma that made the young boy suffer had forced him to hide. But the boy refuses to hide anymore and decides to find the truth.

Episodes.Title: The Note
Episodes.Description: The boys put all the events behind them and moved on with their lives. But a single note starts to connect them once more.

Episodes.Title: Begins ∞ Youth
Episodes.Description: The boys, while adapting to their own lives and beginning to find individual solutions, are confronted with unbearable tragedies that repeat like a treadmill. The boy who realizes the truth takes a step from the end toward a new beginning.

Entries.Title: Bitch X Rich
Entries.Description: Hye-in, a student of Seonwoo Girls' High School, works as a part-timer to make ends meet. One day, she gets a tutoring job for a wealthy middle schooler who wants to go to Cheongdam International High School. While her student is away, Hye-in takes a photo with the student's designer bag, and the photo goes viral.

Episodes.Title: Dirt Poor
Episodes.Description: Hye-in, a student of Seonwoo Girls' High School, works as a part-timer to make ends meet. One day, she gets a tutoring job for a wealthy middle schooler who wants to go to Cheongdam International High School. While her student is away, Hye-in takes a photo with the student's designer bag, and the photo goes viral.

Episodes.Title: The Guilty One
Episodes.Description: Hye-in starts posting more pictures taken with Na-yeon's expensive stuff. She goes overboard and even tries on Cheongdam High's uniform. Na-yeon catches her in the uniform and finds the pictures Hye-in's been uploading. Hye-in begs Na-yeon not to tell her mom about it, and Na-yeon makes Hye-in run errands for her instead.

Episodes.Title: The Witness
Episodes.Description: Na-yeon's family makes complaints to Hye-in's school about her forgery and fraud. Hye-in is on the verge of getting expelled, so she meets the school director of Cheongdam High and begs for mercy. There, she witnesses something she shouldn't have.

Episodes.Title: Barking Up The Wrong Tree
Episodes.Description: Hye-in is offered a place in Cheongdam International High School in return for keeping silent about the incident she witnessed. She buys a new pair of shoes for her new school but accidentally loses them. She runs into Je-na, who happened to be wearing the same shoes and mistakes her for a thief.

Episodes.Title: The Fiery Pit
Episodes.Description: Hye-in forcefully takes the designer shoes off of Je-na and hurts her without knowing who she is. Je-na is determined to make Hye-in's life miserable at school. Do-eon sees Hye-in's application for enrolment in his father's study and decides to approach her.

Episodes.Title: The Sorority Party
Episodes.Description: Do-eon asks Hye-in to tell him what happened on the night Hae-in fell from the rooftop. But Hye-in sets a condition in exchange for telling the truth. Hye-in gets invited to the sorority party, an exclusive party for the rich. There, she runs into Je-na again.

Episodes.Title: The Deal
Episodes.Description: Je-na teaches Hye-in a lesson by ruining her dress and humiliating her at the party. After finding out what happened to Hye-in, Do-eon warns Je-na to stop bullying her. But Je-na pushes Hye-in further and tells her to drop out.

Episodes.Title: The Part-time Job
Episodes.Description: Si-eun tells Hye-in about Lee Duk-min who lends money to the kids in urgent need of money. Hye-in ends up borrowing money from Duk-min without knowing the consequences it could bring. Meanwhile, Do-eon asks Hye-in to help him one more time...

Episodes.Title: Oh Si-eun's True Colours
Episodes.Description: Je-na confronts Si-eun, telling her to leave Hye-in alone, but Si-eun backs her off with the story of her brother. Hye-in is shocked to find out what Si-eun wanted in the first place, but she doesn't back down and finds a way to make it through.

Episodes.Title: Déjà Vu
Episodes.Description: So-mang catches Si-eun and Hye-in in the secluded restroom. After hearing how Si-eun blackmailed Hye-in, he promises to help her. On the day of Yul-hee and Woo-jin's anniversary, the ugly truth gets revealed. Hye-in witnesses something she shouldn't have again.

Episodes.Title: Vengeance Ignited by the Privileged
Episodes.Description: After Oh Si Eun's death, Kim Hye In becomes the prime suspect in the murder investigation. At school, her classmates harass her with scorn, labeling her an 'Equal Opportunity loser.' Realizing that she may never be able to change the course of her life, Hye In resolves to fight back.

Episodes.Title: New Members of Diamond 6 Unveiled
Episodes.Description: Je Na goes through daily distress caused by her family. Her father is on the verge of divorce, and Cha Jin Uk, a suitor with a contract marriage in mind, suddenly enters the picture. Meanwhile, facing expulsion, Hye In proposes a deal to Je Na to include her as a member of Diamond 6. Would Je Na accept Hye In’s offer?

Episodes.Title: Secrets Unfold At Cheongdam High School
Episodes.Description: With Je Na’s help, Hye In makes it into Diamond 6 and decides to act accordingly. Meanwhile, Hae In regains consciousness in the hospital and returns to Cheongdam International High School, but she appears to have lost her memory. Another new student, Jin Uk becomes the subject of gossip. As the backstories of the main characters gradually come to light, will Hye In be able to make it through school life safely?

Episodes.Title: Secrets Unveiled, Bold Moves At The Party
Episodes.Description: Amidst being mistreated and looked down upon for her memory loss, Hae In seems to make up her mind and asks Do Eon to take her as his partner to the party. Meanwhile, Je Na joins the party and reveals her secret in front of everyone. As the main characters make bold moves, what is the secret that Hae In is hiding? And what kind of consequences will it bring?

Episodes.Title: Friend Or Foe, Who Can Be Trusted
Episodes.Description: As relationships twist and allegiances shift, Yul Hui begins reaching out to Je Na’s enemies, determined to bring her down. On Je Na’s side, her once dismissive attitude toward Jin Uk begins to soften and the two form a reluctant yet increasingly cooperative alliance. In a tangled web of betrayal, manipulation, and shifting loyalties, no one can tell who is truly a friend or an enemy.

Episodes.Title: Rumours Of Baek Je Na
Episodes.Description: Hye In interrogates Sa Rang about whether he is actually Black Dog. Ultimately, Sa Rang confesses the truth regarding Oh Si Eun’s cellphone. After hearing Sa Rang’s account, Hye In is convinced that the person who took Si Eun’s phone is the one who pushed Si Eun. Meanwhile, rumours begin to spread about Baek Je Na’s drug abuse.

Episodes.Title: Unravelling The Truth Behind A Murder
Episodes.Description: Framed in a drug scandal orchestrated by Yul Hui, Je Na’s downfall seems imminent, until her allies step in. Meanwhile, Hye In follows a clue tied to a wrist injury and begins to suspect who holds Si Eun’s phone. With everyone hiding their true loyalties and intentions, can Hye In uncover the truth and protect herself before it’s too late?

Episodes.Title: Ties That Strangle
Episodes.Description: Tensions escalate as Hye In is forced into submission, becoming Yul Hui's pawn. However, Yul Hui's schemes unravel when her role in a setup against Je Na is exposed, putting her in a desperate position. Meanwhile, a new strategy emerges to take down Diamond 6 members, with plans to leak the truth through Black Dog's channel.

Episodes.Title: Truth, Betrayal, And A Choice That Changes Everything
Episodes.Description: After Hae In's death, the fragile balance between the characters starts to collapse. Yul Hui pressures Hye In to expose Je Na with a lie during her engagement ceremony with Jin Uk, using a video as leverage. As the fateful day approaches, Hye In stands at a crossroads. With everyone watching, Hye In’s next move could change everything. Will she betray and bring Je Na down, or choose the truth?

Episodes.Title: The Reckoning
Episodes.Description: Despite the risk of revealing herself, Hye In bravely exposes Yul Hui and the web of corruption festering within the school during Je Na's wedding. As her meticulous plan sets off a chain reaction, buried truths begin to surface, drawing everyone deeper into chaos. Loyalties get tested, and tension simmers dangerously close to exploding. Meanwhile, Yul Hui seethes with rage as damning accusations come at her from all sides.

Entries.Title: The Escape of the Seven
Entries.Description: Da-mi, a young high school student with a heart condition, leaves her adoptive parents to live with Geum Ra-hui, her biological mother. When Da-mi arrives at Ra-hui's place, she is overwhelmed by her riches. However, she soon starts to wonder if her mother's intentions are genuine after an incident with her affluent grandfather.

Episodes.Title: Da-Mi Leaves with Her Mother
Episodes.Description: Da-mi, a young high school student with a heart condition, leaves her adoptive parents to live with Geum Ra-hui, her biological mother. When Da-mi arrives at Ra-hui's place, she is overwhelmed by her riches. However, she soon starts to wonder if her mother's intentions are genuine after an incident with her affluent grandfather.

Episodes.Title: The Bobble Incident
Episodes.Description: After a humiliating incident at her new school, Da-mi faints in front of Chil-sung's house. Meanwhile, Mo-ne attracts the attention of multiple entertainment agencies after a stunning audition, including La-hui. However, a rumor surfaces online that could potentially destroy everything she has worked for.

Episodes.Title: Da-mi Leaves La-hui
Episodes.Description: Da Mi leaves La Hui and promises she won't let her receive any money from her grandfather. Meanwhile, Scarlet Letter spreads rumors of Da Mi and her stepfather's promiscuous relationship, causing widespread outrage and chaos. To make things right, Da Mi takes things into her own hands and calls everyone to the park.

Episodes.Title: Da-mi Disappears
Episodes.Description: Da Mi disappears as she broadcasts getting shot live over the Internet, and the person taking the fall is her adoptive father, Lee Hwi So. The people involved get entangled in twisted turmoil while the police search for Da Mi's body. Meanwhile, Bang Chil Sung steps in to find the truth.

Episodes.Title: Party on Jeju Island with Mo-Ne
Episodes.Description: Lee Hwi So gets the death sentence for the murder of Da Mi and Chil Sung. Miraculously, Bang Chil Sung survives the fall and works with Kang Ki Tak to secretly help Hwi So get out of prison so he can avenge Da Mi's death. Meanwhile, Mone becomes a huge star and prepares a special party on Jeju Island to which only thirty-three winners are invited.

Episodes.Title: The Remaining Seven
Episodes.Description: After encountering peril and beating death, the seven people who managed to escape the island alive struggle to stay out of facing trouble with the law. However, all seven of them find a threatening message in their room that shocks them. Meanwhile, Matthew Lee appears just in the nick of time to help the seven survivors with the police investigation.

Episodes.Title: The Gathering of the Seven
Episodes.Description: After learning that Nam Chul-woo was the detective in Da-mi's murder, La-hui senses something out of place and gets Jin-mo to check on Lee Hwi-so. Meanwhile, Mo-ne's guilty conscience haunts her while her relationship with La-hui deteriorates. Later, Matthew gathers the seven survivors and watches them struggle and blame each other for their survival.

Episodes.Title: Chairman Bang's Demise
Episodes.Description: After another death to cover up the incident on the island occurs, Matthew determines to use the Seven to find the mastermind behind it all. Meanwhile, another suspicious letter arrives to each of the Seven with their darkest secrets, causing chaos within the group. They come together to form a plan and go after Chairman Bang, who they learn is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Matthew's Party with the Seven
Episodes.Description: After the TIKITAKA Signing and Inauguration, Matthew hosts a party to celebrate and invites those seven survivors to his home. Meanwhile, Matthew manages to bring Mo-ne's family back to Seoul, and Ji-a threatens Mo-ne about Sim Jun-seok.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Secrets
Episodes.Description: The seven criminals find Ji-a's dead body at her place and straight away realize K is behind it. While they are in panic, Jin-mo gets a phone call from K. Meanwhile, Matthew decides to take everything away from those seven criminals and reveal their crimes to the public, one by one.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Pawns
Episodes.Description: The seven people find out Matthew is Hwi-so, and Do-hyuk has been helping him all this time. He plans to use the seven people as his pawns to fight K and Sungchan Group. He lets them choose whether to die in K's hands or gain the chance to make amends by standing on his side.

Episodes.Title: Matthew Suspects Ki-tak
Episodes.Description: Chairman Sim of Sungchan Group notices TIKITAKA has been challenging him from the beginning. Chairman Sim looks into Matthew and Do-hyuk to fight them back. Meanwhile, Matthew and Do-hyuk are suspicious of Ki-tak and are confused about which side he is on.

Episodes.Title: The Revelations
Episodes.Description: Do-hyuk thinks Ki-tak betrayed him and Matthew without realizing that Matthew was behind everything. Matthew lies to Do-hyuk that Ki-tak is dead when, in fact, he was holding Ki-tak captive. Matthew, who revealed himself as K to Ki-tak, tortures Ki-tak to find out where Chairman Bang’s money is. Meanwhile, Jin-mo reveals to Matthew that K’s child is alive.

Episodes.Title: The New Mission
Episodes.Description: Matthew threatens Jin-mo that he’ll kill Paeng-hee if Do-hyuk ever finds out that he’s K. Do-hyuk barges into Sungchan to find out where Ki-tak went, and he ends up hurting Mo-ne who was there to see the chairman Sim. Meanwhile, another mission is given to them, and this time, they must steal the paintings from Sungchan Gallery.

Episodes.Title: The Intruder
Episodes.Description: Mone helps Do Hyuk escape while he’s being chased by the police, and they run away together. Do Hyuk finds out the identity of K and infiltrates the TIKITAKA building to get him. La Hui accidentally finds where Lee Hwi So is. Meanwhile, Chairman Sim decides to use Do Hyuk and blame him for all the crimes.

Episodes.Title: Trust No One
Episodes.Description: Chairman Sim and Min Do Hyuk’s paternity test results shock the entire nation. Matthew goes to Chairman Sim’s house and lures Do Hyuk there. Chairman Sim throws himself in front of Do Hyuk to stop Matthew from killing him. Cha Ju Ran and Nam Chul Woo manage to break into Chairman Bang’s vault and find his money.

Episodes.Title: The Last Escape
Episodes.Description: Chairman Sim holds a press conference and reveals the truth about Sim Jun Seok. La Hui plans to team up with Ju Ran in order to get away with the life-or-death situation. Meanwhile, K finds out Do Hyuk's hideout through Mone and creates the last escape game just for the seven sinners.

Episodes.Title: Min Do Hyuk Returns
Episodes.Description: The six that held hands with K, the absolute evil, for survival at the crossroads of good and evil live lavish lives in return for Min Do Hyuk's betrayal. However, they are slaves to K and have lost their freedom. Meanwhile, Min Do Hyuk opens his eyes out of a coma he fell into from the explosion he suffered on the rooftop.

Episodes.Title: The Preview of “Dear D”
Episodes.Description: Matthew promotes TIKITAKA's new missing children application, Children Home. During the campaign, Myoung Ji's daughter, Erica, gets abducted. Meanwhile, the movie preview is just around the corner, and Monet worries that the mistakes she made in her life will get exposed to the world. Although she tries to stop the preview from showing, the preview event opens its doors.

Episodes.Title: Do Hyuk Reveals His Face
Episodes.Description: Min Do Hyuk removes his mask and shows himself to Sim Jun Seok, who can't believe he is alive. He is furious that Do Hyuk's trickery got him to clear the charges against him, and he gathers everyone to uncover the traitor. However, Do Hyuk makes his move by winning the hearts of the public, who go crazy over him and his story.

Episodes.Title: Mo Ne’s Will to Survive
Episodes.Description: After rescuing No Han Na, Min Do Hyuk's plan to ensure her safety has Matthew scrambling to find her. The whole country watches as the remaining time runs out. Matthew accuses Mone of working with Min Do Hyuk but gives her a chance to prove her life is worth keeping. Meanwhile, Hwang Chan Sung watches Mone closely with a helping hand.

Episodes.Title: Do Hyuk Gains Access to LUCA
Episodes.Description: At Mone and Chan Sung's engagement party, Matthew tries to get close to Chan Sung, but Chan Sung shuts him down. With Chan Sung at her back, Mone exposes how La Hui and Matthew had kept their eyes on her. Meanwhile, Do Hyuk and Ki Tak break into Matthew's secret room and access LUCA to gain critical data for their next attack.

Episodes.Title: Chan Sung’s True Identity
Episodes.Description: La Hui risks getting exposed and stops Matthew from killing Do Hyuk and Ki Tak. Matthew believes Chan Sung is Medusa and puts Mone on her second mission. Meanwhile, Chan Sung reveals himself as Medusa to Do Hyuk and asks him to join hands against Matthew. However, Do Hyuk senses something isn't right.

Episodes.Title: Medusa Gets Exposed
Episodes.Description: Geum La Hui takes matters into her own hands after getting revealed as Medusa. She begins to trap those involved in Da Mi's death one by one, and ultimately herself, to be judged and punished. Meanwhile, Min Do Hyuk continues to help Mone, which disturbs Chan Sung.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: After leaving a letter for Ki Tak, Geum La Hui starts the game of survival that she plans to broadcast live over Save's network. However, Chan Sung has plans of his own and takes advantage. Meanwhile, Ki Tak races to stop La Hui and save Do Hyuk after he reads La Hui's letter of regret.

Episodes.Title: Who Will Be the Mayor ?
Episodes.Description: The Seoul mayor by-elections are nearing, but Yang Jin Mo trails behind in his campaign. Luckily, Hwang Chan Sung lends his help for something in return. Meanwhile, Mo Ne succumbs to Chan Sung to locate her mother, who she thought was dead, and Do Hyuk reclaims Sungchan Group to take on TIKITAKA and Save.

Episodes.Title: Manipulated Algorithms
Episodes.Description: After the wedding, Mo Ne can't believe what she discovers at Chan Sung's house and hopes she can save her mother. However, she can only succumb to Chan Sung's demands and rely on Min Hyuk with a plan. With Han Na in Chan Sung's hands, Jin Mo seeks help from Min Hyuk and twists Matthew's plans. Meanwhile, Min Hyuk uses Ju Ran and Chul Woo to turn Matthew and Chan Sung against each other.

Episodes.Title: Myoung Ji's Last Wish
Episodes.Description: After getting shot by Matthew, Go Myoung Ji struggles to hang on to her life with Jin Mo and the rest of the people by her side. Meanwhile, Matthew finds a way to escape police custody with Chan Sung's help and tries to manipulate the public in his favour. Later, Do Hyuk and the rest commit to a press conference to expose their sins and corner Matthew.

Episodes.Title: The New Chairman of Sungchan Group
Episodes.Description: Matthew tries to stop Min Do Hyuk's press conference, but it's too late. However, he doesn't give up. Meanwhile, the reporters agree to reveal the evil deeds that stemmed from the Bobble incident and promise to expose Matthew's true identity. Later, Min Do Hyuk becomes Sungchan Group's chairman and reveals himself as Chairman Sim's biological heir.

Episodes.Title: Is Matthew Lee, Lee Hwi So ?
Episodes.Description: Do Hyuk pushes forward with his plans to expose Matthew and starts by releasing S-CURI, an app that safeguards users' secret chats from being spied on. Matthew pours all his effort and money into proving his identity as Lee Hwi So. Meanwhile, Mone works with Do Hyuk to turn Chan Sung against Matthew.

Episodes.Title: Yang Jin Mo’s Demise
Episodes.Description: Yang Jin Mo dies. He leaves his heart for Go Myoung Ji and saves her life. Matthew uses his power and connections to make Min Do Hyuk look like Yang Jin Mo's murderer. Meanwhile, Min Do Hyuk comes up with a new plan, and Han Mo Ne is there to help him.

Episodes.Title: Matthew Destroys Do Hyuk’s Plans
Episodes.Description: Despite Mo Ne's involvement in Da Mi's death, Ki Tak saves her from Chan Sung's wrath and keeps her out of harm's way. However, Ki Tak gets taken hostage by Matthew as she makes her getaway. Upon discovery of Chan Sung's murder, Matthew gets the upper hand by framing Do Hyuk as the murderer and destroys his plan. Meanwhile, Myoung Ji recovers and plots her revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Min Do Hyuk corners Matthew and exposes the truth behind all his evil deeds in front of the press as his final blow. With no way to escape the accusations, Matthew takes matters into his own hands, creating carnage. Meanwhile, Mo Ne turns herself in as Chan Sung's murderer, and the prosecution goes after Matthew.

Entries.Title: Crash Course in Romance
Entries.Description: As competition in her class ramps up, Nam Hae-e anxiously awaits her math score. Choi Chi-yeol is embroiled in a scandal involving one of his students.

Episodes.Title: You and I, the Intersection of Two Universes
Episodes.Description: As competition in her class ramps up, Nam Hae-e anxiously awaits her math score. Choi Chi-yeol is embroiled in a scandal involving one of his students.

Episodes.Title: Probability of Encountering Your Enemy at Your Worst
Episodes.Description: Nam Haeng-seon attempts to register Hae-e into The Pride Academy. Desperate for Haeng-seon's food, Chi-yeol visits her store in a disguise.

Episodes.Title: Number of Outcomes Where Dislike Becomes Like
Episodes.Description: Haeng-seon begins fawning over Chi-yeol after discovering his true identity. A change in the Pride Academy's schedule creates a stir among the parents.

Episodes.Title: Revolt of the Arithmetic Sequence
Episodes.Description: Haeng-seon gets a taste of the vicious politics among the academy's parents. She later goes to great lengths to make things right for Hae-e.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Probability Distribution of X and Y
Episodes.Description: Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol work out an arrangement for Hae-e's tutoring. A mysterious tragedy leaves the academy and its parents rattled.

Episodes.Title: There Are No Correct Answers in Life, Only Best Answers
Episodes.Description: A painful past comes back to haunt Chi-yeol. Bang Su-a becomes suspicious of Hae-e after finding her secret worksheets on her desk.

Episodes.Title: The Very Average Laws of Attraction
Episodes.Description: Hae-e ranks first in her class, causing drama among other parents. Chi-yeol and Haeng-seon grow closer as he spends more time with her family.

Episodes.Title: Chance Becomes Fate through Inductive Reasoning
Episodes.Description: Haeng-seon realizes her own feelings after seeing Chi-yeol at the academy. Su-a connects the dots and begins to make sense of Hae-e's recent successes.

Episodes.Title: The Butterfly Effect of Our Relationship
Episodes.Description: Chi-yeol and Haeng-seon deal with the fallout after their secret is discovered — forcing the two to confront what it means for them moving forward.

Episodes.Title: Emotion, the Variable That Alters Relationships
Episodes.Description: A public revelation leaves Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol's relationship in limbo. Meanwhile, Chi-yeol faces the repercussions of recent events.

Episodes.Title: The Functional Relationship of Our Love
Episodes.Description: Tired of her loved ones facing scrutiny, Hae-e makes a bold confession to the world. Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol navigate their road ahead post-scandal.

Episodes.Title: Point of Intersection between Comedy and Tragedy
Episodes.Description: A shocking arrest leaves the academy's parents — and Hae-e — concerned. Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol maneuver the days after their first fight.

Episodes.Title: How We Approach an Unsolvable Conjecture
Episodes.Description: Hae-e attempts to get a hold of Lee Sun-jae after being put in a difficult position at school. Haeng-seon catches Ji Dong-hui in a hostile moment.

Episodes.Title: Find the Unique Solution
Episodes.Description: News about Hae-e leaves those around her feeling rattled. Haeng-seon begins to suspect something's off. Chi-yeol confronts Dong-hui about his behavior.

Episodes.Title: The Result of Chance and Inevitability
Episodes.Description: Lee Sun-jae's confession ignites a scandal at the school. Chi-yeol attempts to put an end to Dong-hui's scheme before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: You and I, the Union of Two Universes
Episodes.Description: Grappling with her mother's return, Hae-e announces a shocking decision. Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol make a pivotal choice about their future.

Episodes.Description: Ji-eum and Seo-ha share more heartfelt moments. Cho-won summons up the courage to make a daring move.

Episodes.Description: Seo-ha butts heads with the CEO of MI Grand Hotel. Kim Ae-gyeong welcomes a new worker at her restaurant — but Ji-eum is wary.

Episodes.Title: The Spot In One's Heart From Longing
Episodes.Description: When Ban Dong-u gets entangled with loan sharks, Ji-eum takes matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Dong-u happens upon a shocking revelation.

Episodes.Title: The Ones Who Share Each Others' Joy and Sorrow
Episodes.Description: Seo-ha's world comes tumbling down when a mysterious phone call reveals an uncomfortable truth. He later shares an intimate moment with Ji-eum.

Episodes.Title: Casting One's Fate Unto the Dice
Episodes.Description: Ji-eum continues to deal with her troublesome family. Jang Yeon-ok receives a bouquet of flowers — but finds an ominous note tucked inside.

Episodes.Title: You're Bound to Meet Someone You've Parted With
Episodes.Description: Seo-ha reckons with Ji-eum's confession. Han-na and Ji-eum join forces. During a confrontation with Seo-ha, Lee Sang-hyuck reveals his motives.

Episodes.Title: Everything Has a Beginning and an End
Episodes.Description: Ji-eum receives alarming news about Ae-gyeong. Cho-won continues to pursue Ha Do-yun. Seo-ha receives a curious gift that leaves him puzzled.

Episodes.Title: No Such Thing as Retreat
Episodes.Description: Ji-eum gets more glimpses into her very first life, which leaves her completely devastated. Kang Min-gi meets with Seo-ha and offers him advice.

Episodes.Title: The One Who Tied the Knot Must Untie It
Episodes.Description: After coming to a shocking realization about her unique abilities, Ji-eum is faced with a critical dilemma — what path will she choose for herself?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Cha Jeong-suk witnesses a frightening incident and freezes amid the chaos. She later receives a scary diagnosis — sending Seo In-ho into a spiral.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Back from the brink of death, Jeong-suk decides to live life differently — claiming her independence by making an ambitious career move.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jeong-suk's acceptance leaves In-ho and Choi Seung-hi reeling. Jeong-suk attempts to adjust to her new role — but finds opposition from all sides.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After an eventful night out, Jeong-suk gets closer with Roy Kim — irritating In-ho. At the hospital, she continues to struggle amid the chaos.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Rumors surrounding Jeong-suk and In-ho's relations arise. After Seung-hi puts her through the ringer, Jeong-suk wonders if she's cut out for the job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Despite being singled out for praise, Jeong-suk faces belittlement from In-ho. Roy confronts In-ho about his behavior, later befriending Jeong-suk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Jeong-suk clashes with In-ho about their daughter. She later finds evidence of her son's relationship. Seung-hi confronts Roy about his recent discovery.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8

Entries.Title: Brewing Love
Entries.Description: After wrapping up another case of an unpaid bill, Yong -ju gets dragged into another dilemma with the competition. Although it's resolved amicably, she hears her sales branch is on the verge of closing due to an extremely loved craft beer. Meanwhile, Min-ju continues to brew his Naro Beer, the beer everyone loves, in the Chungcheong Province while giving Chan-hui a job and blocking out the things that overwhelm him.

Episodes.Title: A Beer Worth Tasting
Episodes.Description: After wrapping up another case of an unpaid bill, Yong -ju gets dragged into another dilemma with the competition. Although it's resolved amicably, she hears her sales branch is on the verge of closing due to an extremely loved craft beer. Meanwhile, Min-ju continues to brew his Naro Beer, the beer everyone loves, in the Chungcheong Province while giving Chan-hui a job and blocking out the things that overwhelm him.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Down Walls
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju gets a chance to save the Busan branch and heads to work at the head office. All she needs to do is win over Yoon Min-ju to work with Jisang Liquor. After realizing he was the man she met at the carnival, she learns how difficult Min-ju could be. However, Yong-ju doesn't give up, and her strong mentality begins to break down his walls.

Episodes.Title: Uilhan Hop Beer Festival
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju's persistence works its way down Min-ju's nerves, but he still has room for her as the empath he is. However, he still pushes her away. While the town prepares for the Uilhan Hop Beer Festival, Yong-ju doesn't give up and heads to the Uilhan Pub to drink as much as she can, causing Min-ju to show up. Meanwhile, Ah-reum gathers the town for a meeting and reveals something shocking.

Episodes.Title: Brewing Tension
Episodes.Description: Convincing Yoon Min-ju to collaborate with Jisang Liquor is proving challenging for Yong-ju. However, she’s unwilling to exploit his vulnerabilities to secure his agreement. Facing open hostility from the villagers, she opts for a patient approach, hoping Min-ju will eventually recognise her genuine intentions. Meanwhile, a significant part of the beer festival preparations go wrong just before the event is set to begin.

Episodes.Title: Cheating Not Allowed
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju and her task force team members have a workshop in a coastal city. Watching Yong-ju jump into the ocean to save a person from drowning, Min-ju realizes that his feelings for Yong-ju are growing. Also, they learn that their competitor is playing a cheat to increase its sales. Meanwhile, Chan-hwi witnesses Ah-reum working part-time at a convenience store and discovers a big secret about Ah-reum.

Episodes.Title: Finding Spy
Episodes.Description: The higher-ups of Jisang Liquor suddenly decide to change the business strategy for the new product Yong-ju and Min-ju are working on together. Yong-ju strongly believes that there’s a spy in her task force behind the higher-ups' decision. When Min-ju is short of hands with the rising volume of orders from his clients, unexpected supporters arrive at his brewery to offer help.

Episodes.Title: Happy Families
Episodes.Description: After learning that Yong-ju is his saviour, Min-ju falls head over heels for her, but something tells him something isn't right. He terrorises the town for comfort, driving the townspeople mad. Meanwhile, the first beer sample produced between Uilhan Brewery and Jisang Liquor is poured and tasted. Later, Min-ju discovers that Yong-ju's grandmother's health conditions could have been his fault, pushing him to retreat into the mountains.

Episodes.Title: Hello and Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju struggles to understand her feelings toward Min-ju. Sensing this, Min-ju reassures her that he won’t rush her and will wait until she’s ready. However, when Min-ju’s high school friend and former girlfriend pays him a visit, it stirs jealousy in Yong-ju. Later, Min-ju invites Yong-ju on a date, but as she returns home afterwards, she notices an unusual and unsettling silence in the house.

Episodes.Title: Special Ordinary Days
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju's deeply crushed heart from her grandmother's passing pulls Min-ju even closer. As she grieves, Min-ju persuades her to join his village's first-ever sports festival, where the village people lend their support. Meanwhile, Yong-ju musters up her courage to profess her affection for Min-ju, and the YouTuber from the landslide returns with a sinister motive involving Jjuan, a beauty he can't believe is with Soon-kwan.

Episodes.Title: Internal and External Battles
Episodes.Description: Contrary to what Yong-ju and Min-ju had hoped, the internal evaluation of their latest beer lineup yielded disastrous results. Sensing internal opposition, they propose an irresistible offer to revive their new beer. Meanwhile, Chan-hwi battles his past traumas, which threaten to take away the love of his life.

Episodes.Title: Tangled In Love and Brew
Episodes.Description: Recognising the taste inconsistencies between batches of their newly launched beer lineup, Yong-ju and Min-ju find themselves debating fiercely over the best way to address this expensive problem. While their love for each other is strong enough to move mountains, their vastly different ways of expressing it leaves Yong-ju feeling deeply hurt. Just as they believe they've managed to contain the situation, it quickly spirals out of control.

Episodes.Title: Finding a New Path
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju cracks down on the malicious online sabotagers hired by Baekmok Liquor and works to revive Together's tarnished image. With a bit of help from the chairman of the National Liquor Wholesalers Association, Yong-ju and the team captured the hearts of their partners, selling all their beer. Meanwhile, Yong-ju deeply contemplates the next chapter of her life as she sits at her desk writing her resignation letter.

Ji Yu fails to find friends after the semester begins, but A Ra, the transferring student, approaches Ji Yu. Meanwhile, Ji Yu starts have doubts about Chan Seong - her entire world.

Episodes.Description: As Ji Yu is in agony, the person who understands her is San, who is always by her side. Meanwhile, due to an incident with Do Ha, an older student, Ji Yu experiences an unexpected event. Ji Yu feels better as Chan Seong is sweet to her but not completely. Then Do Ha comes to Ji Yu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Ji Yu starts spending time with her new friends. During this time, Ji Yu's relationship with Chan Seong gradually suffers. At the same time, the two suppress their frustrations over unresolved issues. Meanwhile, Ji Yu meets up with Do Ha, who keeps advancing to her, and San finds out, even though it was supposed to be a secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After talking to San, Ji-yu wants to be honest with Chan-seong, but it doesn't go her way; the more she tries to explain, the more Chan-seong misunderstands; in the end, Ji-yu is fed up and the two turn their backs against each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ji-yu meets with Chan-seong to have a talk and clear up a misunderstanding; she experiences an unexpected conflict with Mi-na later on; Ji-yu, who becomes the subject of a rumor once again, tries to resolve the situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After clearing things up with Mi-na, Ji-yu and her friends pay a visit to the gynecologist. Meanwhile, to make things right, Ji-yu goes to find Do-ha to rectify things. Chan-sung goes to meet Ji-yu after hearing about the rumors, but an uninvited guest shows up and things turn ugly. As the situation worsens, Ji-yu hears surprising news from San.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ji-yu is confused about Mi-na and San getting along so well. Then, Ji-yu gets hate DMs from an anonymous Instagram account. Instead of running away, Ji-yu makes up her mind to face reality. Taking courage, Ji-yu meets up with Chan-sung who has been avoiding her to have they heart-to-heart talk they couldn't have and share a genuine conversation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ji-yu decides to make decisions only for herself and decides to break up with Chan-sung. Then Ji-yu apologizes to Su-jin, who she must have been hurting all along. Meanwhile, sports day is coming up at Jungang High. Looking for San, Ji-yu goes to the nurse's office and sees something shocking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After finding herself in another precarious situation, Ye-bun experiences a shocking vision. Jang-yeol scours the town for a potentially exciting case.

Episodes.Description: Faced with a tragedy, Jang-yeol tries to track down the person responsible. Ye-bun discovers a shocking scene after experiencing a vision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12

Ye-bun bursts into his home with a theory that connects all new dots in a terrifying way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16

Episodes.Description: Eun-ho and Hyun-oh, once a couple, now clash at the news station over an evening show that Eun-ho refuses to accept. Hyun-oh proposes to take the job to alleviate the situation, but they end up working together. Episodes.Title: The Connection Between You and Me
Episodes.Description: Hyun-oh meets Eun-ho, but she doesn’t recognise him, saying she’s not Eun-ho. Hye-ri and Joo-yeon become closer and Joo-yeon takes her into his house. Meanwhile, Eun-ho joins Mi-yeon and her crew to cover a serious social issue. While secretly filming footage alone, Eun-ho gets in danger and struggles to survive.

Episodes.Title: Wind
Episodes.Description: Hyun-oh saves Eun-ho but doesn't get the thanks he should and only gets another stern warning to stay away from her. Jeon Jae-yong returns to the station and stirs things up after seeing Eun-ho working in Media N Seoul Parkade. Meanwhile, Hye-ri and Joo-yeon get closer, but Eun-ho wakes up to find Joo-yeon's employee card and goes to meet him.

Episodes.Title: Love is a Star
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho smashes a mirror and faints. She doesn’t remember anything about it. She tells the doctor that she has found happiness and doesn’t want to abandon Hye-ri. Meanwhile, when Eun-ho and Hyun-oh deliver the news, a clip regarding two sisters reminds Eun-ho of her past and she panics in the newsroom.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho wakes up to see Hyun-oh with her. She can't remember what happened after the elevator and figure out why he is with her. After seeing her doctor at Hyun-oh's request, she realises the Hye-ri inside her struggles to break free to hold onto the happiness Eun-ho doesn't have. Hyun-oh stays by her side as if they never broke up. Meanwhile, Joo-yeon can't get Hye-ri off his mind and rushes to see her only to be with Hyun-oh.

Episodes.Title: The History of Farewells
Episodes.Description: Hyun-oh’s gambler father died in a fire accident when Hyun-oh was a minor. When Hyun-oh was about to be sent to an orphanage, the boss of Red Rainbow offered him a place to stay under one condition. Because of his complicated background, Hyun-oh always hesitates about marriage. Meanwhile, Hyun-oh’s place of 9pm news gets replaced. It turns out that Hyun-oh exchanged his 9pm news position for Eun-ho’s noon news position.

Episodes.Title: Pretending To Be Hye Ri
Episodes.Description: Eun Ho decides to live as Hye Ri one more time. Pretending to be Hye Ri, she participates in a dodgeball game with Joo Yeon on a sports day of Media N Seoul. However, Joo Yeon soon finds out that Eun Ho and Hye Ri are the same person. Meanwhile, Eun Ho and Shin Joong try to come up with an idea of how to help Hyun Oh get the opportunity to become the 9pm news anchor.

Entries.Title: Perfect Marriage Revenge
Entries.Description: Yi-joo is perceived as a gentle soul, selflessly putting others first. However, the disrespect she endures is far from what she deserves. Her longing for a family leads her down a path of righteousness, but everything crumbles at the Han Gallery Charity Auction. Faced with unspeakable horrors, a fatal accident befalls her, and in her dwindling breath, she prays for a chance at redemption.

Episodes.Title: Hope's Second Breath
Episodes.Description: Yi-joo is perceived as a gentle soul, selflessly putting others first. However, the disrespect she endures is far from what she deserves. Her longing for a family leads her down a path of righteousness, but everything crumbles at the Han Gallery Charity Auction. Faced with unspeakable horrors, a fatal accident befalls her, and in her dwindling breath, she prays for a chance at redemption.

Episodes.Title: Another Shot at Life
Episodes.Description: Having realized that she's returned to a point before her marriage, Yi-joo decides to navigate a different life course. Her stepmother and stepsister, no longer considered part of her familial circle, morph into her most formidable adversaries. She initiates the process by breaking off the wedding with a man more inclined toward her sister, and then she orchestrates a scheme to sow intricate chaos within her supposed family.

Episodes.Title: Would You Live with Me?
Episodes.Description: It's only through reading an article about a small incident in the park with Do-guk that Yi-joo uncovers his ulterior motive. Confronting him, she presses for an explanation, and to her delight, it turns out to be quite heartwarming. To add to the surprise, Do-guk proposes that she reside in his house, minus his presence. Feeling a sense of dependability, Yi-joo cherishes the moment, unaware of the uncertainties ahead.

Episodes.Title: A Line to be Crossed
Episodes.Description: The next phase unfolds in Yi-joo and Do-guk's contractual marriage as their families meet for the initial discussion regarding their impending union. Jeong-hye remains oblivious to Yi-joo's orchestration and her amazement deepens when Yi-joo presents one of her replicas as a surprising gift. Despite the surface portrayal, Yi-joo employs stern language with Do-guk, reminding him not to cross boundaries in their feigned marriage. Do-guk struggles to mask his evident disappointment.

Episodes.Title: Crossing the Line
Episodes.Description: The day after the incident at the ferry port, Yi-joo learns that Do-guk is dealing with a panic disorder. Believing that Jung-wook holds crucial information about Do-guk's condition, she arranges a meeting with him, going against Do-guk's explicit request not to meet him. Despite her worry for Do-guk, he sternly warns her not to cross the boundaries of their contractual relationship. Seeking comfort, Yi-joo visits her grandfather and encounters an incredible story about her birth.

Episodes.Title: The Tearful Wedding
Episodes.Description: Yi-joo comes close to a regrettable choice at her wedding with Do-guk, driven by the realization of Jeong-hye's manipulation, but Do-guk intervenes just in time. The morning after the wedding, Do-guk discovers a note from Yi-joo and her empty room. Meanwhile, Yu-ra views Jung-wook as an ideal instrument for her schemes.

Episodes.Title: Another Contract
Episodes.Description: Even though it all began as a contractual arrangement between Yi-joo and Do-guk, her sentiments for him evolved over time. On the flip side, Yu-ra and Jung-wook seem on the verge of establishing their own agreement driven by sheer greed. Their sinister intentions promptly take shape as they expose the confidential contract between Yi-joo and Do-guk to the entire family.

Episodes.Title: Whispers of Revelation
Episodes.Description: Now that the secret pact between Do-guk and Yi-joo has come to light, the entire family is rife with disappointment and demands for justification. Jung-wook seizes this moment to press Do-guk even harder, but Do-guk appears to be one step ahead in every move. Meanwhile, Yi-joo's plan faces unexpected disruptions as rumors about her begin circulating and spiraling out of control.

Episodes.Title: Discoveries and Suspicions
Episodes.Description: With Jin-woong in the hospital, Jeong-hye declares herself the new interim chairman of Hanul. With plans to make her position permanent, she starts trying to win over shareholders. However, Yi-joo is onto her plan and starts doing the same. Meanwhile, Jin-woong becomes aware of Yi-joo's identity and starts to suspect Jeong-hye.

Episodes.Title: Yu-ra's Reality Starts to Shift
Episodes.Description: Jeong-hye's plans to take over Hanul for good fail as Chairman Han Woon-jae, Yi-joo, and Yi-joo's birth mother speak against her at the shareholders' meeting. Meanwhile, Yu-ra discovers that she is pregnant with Jung-wook's child and that Yi-joo is Jin-woong's biological daughter. She slowly comes to realize that her perspective of reality has been wrong all along.

Episodes.Title: Jeong-hye and Jung-wook's Downfall
Episodes.Description: Cho Dong-soo rats out Jeong-hye to the police, and they both get arrested. Yi-joo and Do-guk seem to enjoy their lives until Do-guk confesses that he is the reason why they both came back in time. Meanwhile, a construction site worker hired by Taeja's subcontractor dies on the job. Jung-wook tries to sweep things under the rug.

Episodes.Title: Changing the Future for the Better
Episodes.Description: Jung-wook breaks out of jail and kidnaps Yi-joo in an attempt to torment Do-guk. However, Do-guk is determined to save Yi-joo from the same fate that made them go back in time that fateful day, even if it means risking his own life to do so. As their repeated time draws to an end, Yi-joo and Do-guk feel unsure about what will happen in their future. Will they find happiness and peace in the end?
