Entries.Title: Duty After School
Entries.Description: For a year, people learn to live with the spheres without suffering any specific changes. Even with the alien-looking spheres floating all over the sky, the CSAT is what matters the most to seniors of Sungjin High School. When the exam is just around the corner, one of the spheres drops on a military camp for the first time, and more shocking news awaits them.

Episodes.Title: Question the Spheres
Episodes.Description: For a year, people learn to live with the spheres without suffering any specific changes. Even with the alien-looking spheres floating all over the sky, the CSAT is what matters the most to seniors of Sungjin High School. When the exam is just around the corner, one of the spheres drops on a military camp for the first time, and more shocking news awaits them.

Episodes.Title: Military Training Begins
Episodes.Description: After spheres from the sky drop to the ground, military training begins for the students to ensure their safety. However, the students find it too demanding and have a difficult time. As students head to the shooting range to learn how to shoot, they get caught off guard and fall into a crisis. Meanwhile, a student gets killed by one of the spheres.

Episodes.Title: School Escape
Episodes.Description: Two people from Class Two die. To prevent chaos, this news is not yet known throughout the entire school. After their deaths, students of Class Two get sick of all the hardcore training and try to escape school to go back to their homes. However, all their attempts go to waste and the biggest attack of the spheres begins.

Episodes.Title: Become the Villain
Episodes.Description: The first vehicle gets attacked by a sphere and turned over. The soldier dies on the spot, and So-yeon gets badly injured. The students decide to leave the vehicle and find a shelter nearby. Soon, they find a construction site office where they can hide and rest. However, their peace doesn’t last long. Meanwhile, Lieutenant Lee goes against the order and steals a vehicle to rescue the students.

Episodes.Title: Will We Ever Go Home?
Episodes.Description: Chun-ho tries to make sure that the kids all survive so they can return safely to the camp. The kids after having gone through a common struggle begin to bond with each other. They also begin to learn more things about being a soldier. But there seems to be a more ominous order awaiting them from high command. Will they make it through another day?

Episodes.Title: Fight Or Flight
Episodes.Description: After a heated encounter with the spheres, the group picked up some survivors. However, the heavily traumatized survivors have a hard time blending in and coping with the situation. Their outbursts and dire situation make the group rethink their morals and imperatives. Will they carry on with the mission or will they flee for their own safety?

Episodes.Title: Disagreement Among Classmates
Episodes.Description: Children in Class 3-2 who have become accustomed to both the sphere and death. I find laughter again, but I didn't know that a crack was forming in it. Along the way, he meets strangers who ask for help.

Episodes.Title: Prisoners at Yongwon Penitentiary
Episodes.Description: Platoon Two encounter prisoners at the Yongwon Penitentiary. Since there are no prison guards, they have been locked up without any food supplies for a while now, and they threaten the kids to open the cell doors. One of the prisoners hands over a photo of his mother and begs Ae-seol to contact her for him. Meanwhile, at Yongdu Service Area, intruders barge in and look around the place.

Episodes.Title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
Episodes.Description: While trying to save Bo-ra, Soo-chul sacrifices himself. Everyone wonders what they should do with his body when suddenly someone mentions that Soo-chul rigged voting. After finding out the truth behind the voting, they break into a fight. Then they find out why Soo-chul had to manipulate votes, which comes as a shock.

Episodes.Title: End of the War
Episodes.Description: After aborting the mission, the kids walk for days but get to nowhere. However, they reach an amusement park and have fun as if it is their last. Meanwhile, Yeong-soo is not comfortable about walking away from the mission as he still believes the CSAT is not canceled. The end of the war draws near, but the kids have a long way left to survival.

Entries.Title: Death's Game
Entries.Description: After enduring seven years of relentless job hunting and daily struggle, Yee-jae finally decides to end his own life. After death, he encounters a mysterious entity.

Episodes.Title: Death
Episodes.Description: After enduring seven years of relentless job hunting and daily struggle, Yee-jae finally decides to end his own life. After death, he encounters a mysterious entity.

Episodes.Title: The Reason You're Going to Hell.
Episodes.Description: Yee-jae doesn't understand why he's being punished and protests as he continues to face Death's retribution.

Episodes.Title: Death Can't Take Anything Away.
Episodes.Description: As he continues to undergo Death's unpredictable trials, Yee-jae decides to take steps to prepare for his next life, unbeknownst to Death.

Episodes.Title: The Reason You're Afraid of Death.
Episodes.Description: Death mocks humans, asserting that they desperately struggle to live only after they have died. In this life, Yee-jae reunites with someone he's missed dearly.

Episodes.Title: It Is Impossible to Break Free and Fight against Death.
Episodes.Description: Death warns that it will intervene if Yee-jae ever attempts to kill someone, but Yee-jae dismisses the warning as he prepares his revenge.

Episodes.Title: Memory
Episodes.Description: Yee-jae plans to accomplish what the world has failed to do, while Tae-u begins his counterattack.

Episodes.Title: Opportunity
Episodes.Description: Yee-jae realizes that no matter how many times he's reborn, it's meaningless if he doesn't live as himself.

Episodes.Title: Don't Go Looking For Death. Death Will Come Find You.
Episodes.Description: Just one final bullet remains. Will Yee-jae be able to evade death and survive?

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Young-soon pushes Kang-ho to the limits. She later finds a perplexing item from her son's old life. Mi-joo navigates her complex feelings around Kang-ho.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Young-soon and Kang-ho go through recollections of Kang-ho's past — discovering another side to his story.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Young-soon prepares Kang-ho for a safer future. After a startling incident, Mi-joo and Kang-ho share a tender moment — further complicating their lives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: With Mi-joo by his side, Kang-ho finds out the truth after an alarming moment. Bang Sam-sik gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: After a frightening incident at the farm, Young-soon discovers more information. As Kang-ho proceeds with his plan, Mi-joo and Sam-sik follow suit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Mi-joo and Sam-sik risk their safety to track down a key witness. Young-soon finds support from her friends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Kang-ho enacts his final plan to take down Oh Tae-soo. Young-soon gives Kang-ho and Mi-joo her blessings.

Entries.Title: My Lovely Liar
Entries.Description: The Liar Hunter Mok Sol-hee uses her special power to make money. One day when she is running away to Seoul, she meets a mysterious boy on the bus. Although he is just a random person to her, she later finds out far in the future that he is the worldwide famous composer Kim Do-ha.

Episodes.Title: The Liar Hunter
Episodes.Description: The Liar Hunter Mok Sol-hee uses her special power to make money. One day when she is running away to Seoul, she meets a mysterious boy on the bus. Although he is just a random person to her, she later finds out far in the future that he is the worldwide famous composer Kim Do-ha.

Episodes.Title: The New Neighbor
Episodes.Description: Sol-hee helps Do-ha escape from the town residents. But she later finds out that he is a new neighbor who moves into the apartment where Sol-hee lives. Meanwhile, Deuk-chan gets blackmailed by Moo-jin. By force, he sets up a meeting where Do-ha must face Moo-jin face to face. To uncover his secrets, Moo-jin hires Sol-hee to come to the meeting.

Episodes.Title: Every Family Has Problems
Episodes.Description: Sol-hee feels bad that Do-ha has not returned home after that incident. After a few days, Do-ha and Sol-hee run into each other in front of their apartment. Meanwhile, Syaon ends up in a hospital after she sprains her ankle on stage. Sol-hee's mother tries to get some pocket money from Sol-hee by giving false excuses without getting caught.

Episodes.Title: Wheel of Fortune
Episodes.Description: Sol-hee let Do-ha hide in her apartment to dodge the reporters. Then Sol-hee realizes that he has not told a single lie to her so far, and she is confused about whether her ability does not work on him or he is telling the truth. Therefore, Sol-hee tries to hang out with him more often to make him say a lie. Meanwhile, Kang-min receives a report at Sol-hee's apartment.

Episodes.Title: The Imposter
Episodes.Description: Sol-hee finally hears Do-ha's first lie, which is the most unexpected and terrifying to find out. Sol-hee decides to stay out of his life now that she figured out her ability works well on him, and he is also an ordinary person, but she can't stop thinking about him. Meanwhile, a man with a mask posts a video of him, saying he is Kim Do-ha.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Guests
Episodes.Description: With the help of Sol-hee, Do-ha stops covering his face with a mask outside. Their feelings for each other grow stronger as they go through challenges together. Just when everything seems perfect, Sol-hee runs into her mother while working for one of her clients, and someone comes to see Deuk-chan to ask about Do-ha.

Episodes.Title: The Bakery Incident
Episodes.Description: Even though Sol-hee confessed her ability to Do-ha, he stays closer to her and treats her the same, unlike everybody else. Both Sol-hee and Do-ha finally have each other who they can trust and rely on. Meanwhile, Do-ha and Sol-hee visit Yeonseo Bakery and find something fishy about a customer.

Episodes.Title: The Worst Lie
Episodes.Description: Whenever Do-ha denies that he committed murder, Sol-hee can hear that it is a lie. It breaks her heart as she believed he is the only person who does not lie about anything, yet he told her the worst lie of all. Meanwhile, Deuk-chan wants Do-ha to move out of the apartment and stay away from Sol-hee now that she finds out about Seung-ju.

Episodes.Title: The Truth Behind Hakcheon Beach Case
Episodes.Description: Do-ha tells Sol-hee everything about what happened back in his hometown with Eom-ji. Do-ha clears up the misunderstanding and returns to his apartment in Yeonseo-dong with Sol-hee. Meanwhile, Kang-min finds out about the Hakcheon Beach case, and Eom-ho gets to Syaon.

Episodes.Title: Yeon-mi Visits Luni Tarot Cafe
Episodes.Description: Kang-min saves Do-ha from Eom-ho. He warns Do-ha to keep Sol-hee safe and not to let her find out about the incident. Meanwhile, Deuk-chan tells Yeon-mi about Sol-hee. Yeon-mi visits Sol-hee's cafe and sees Do-ha and Sol-hee together.

Episodes.Title: Bones Get Discovered
Episodes.Description: Bones get discovered on a mountainside in Hakcheon, and the police get called to investigate. Kang-min thinks it could be the skeleton of Choi Eom-ji, the missing girl. As he waits for DNA analysis to finish, Kang-min asks Sol-hee about Seung-ju one last time. Meanwhile, J Entertainment ends it's relationship with Do-ha and Syaon.

Episodes.Title: Search for the Truth
Episodes.Description: The public discovers that Do-ha is the primary suspect in the case, and he becomes the public target. People are quick to point fingers and criticize him. Fed up with the situation, Do-ha decides he will no longer wait and take matters into his own hands. He decides to find the culprit himself to clear his name.

Episodes.Title: The Suspect
Episodes.Description: Do-ha successfully located Eom-ji's father, Yong-guk, whom Do-ha suspects to be the prime suspect. Yong-guk admits that he had hoped for Eom-ji's death to claim her insurance money but denies being involved in her murder. He reveals to Do-ha that Jae-chan used to constantly follow Eom-ji around.

Episodes.Title: Uncovering the Truth
Episodes.Description: Jo Jae-chan turns himself in to the police and confesses to the murder of Eom-ji. With the culprit now in custody, Do-ha and Sol-hee celebrate with their friends for Do-ha proving his innocence. While they can resume their usual life, Do-ha still has lingering unease in his mind. So Do-ha and Sol-hee decide to investigate further.

Episodes.Title: Do-ha Learns the Truth
Episodes.Description: Sol-hee wakes up in the hospital without any issues from the accident. Luckily, Jae-chan also survives after undergoing surgery, and finally, he gets to tell Do-ha the truth about what happened that night with Eom-ji. Later, Sol-hee learns she's lost her ability and learns to cope with living without it.

Episodes.Title: The Liar Hunter's Final Task
Episodes.Description: Tae-seop stops Hyang-suk from marrying a man she doesn't love and proposes to her. But Hyang-suk turns him down, telling him harsh things she doesn't really mean. Right then, Sol-hee's ability to detect lies comes back again. Meanwhile, Do-ha gives Ethan a song as a gift and helps produce his first solo album.

Entries.Title: My Demon
Entries.Description: An accidental date with Jeong Gu-won leaves Do Do-Hee feeling flustered. She later becomes a victim of an attack — where a rescue requires a contract.

Episodes.Title: Living in the Mist
Episodes.Description: An accidental date with Jeong Gu-won leaves Do Do-Hee feeling flustered. She later becomes a victim of an attack — where a rescue requires a contract.

Episodes.Title: Everyone Has a Demon in Their Heart
Episodes.Description: Gu-won inexplicably loses his power — and finds that Do-hee might be the key to regaining it. But his efforts to take back his abilities backfire.

Episodes.Title: Joining Hands with a Demon
Episodes.Description: After another attack, Do-hee asks Gu-won to be her guard — even after his admission as a demon. Do-hee finds the loss of someone close suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Sweet but Dangerous
Episodes.Description: Do-hee proposes to Gu-won, but he refuses. She later recruits him to investigate Ju Cheon-suk's death, but he faces an unexpected power blockage.

Episodes.Title: Only You
Episodes.Description: After a dramatic rescue, Gu-won and Do-hee begin having complex feelings for each other. Do-hee later tries to find a man to marry — frustrating Gu-won.

Episodes.Title: Into the Wheel of Fortune
Episodes.Description: After Gu-won saves Do-hee's life, she receives competing marriage proposals. She ends up choosing one, and finds an alarming face at her wedding.

Episodes.Title: Stained Relationships
Episodes.Description: Do-hee and Gu-won go through newlywed pains as they move in together. Ju Seok-hoon begins to suspect Gu-won's non-human identity.

Episodes.Title: The Fateful Choice
Episodes.Description: After a sudden attack on Gu-won, Do-hee rushes to save his life — and as life around her becomes more dangerous, she makes a surprising career move.

Episodes.Title: The Unmasked Truth
Episodes.Description: As Do-hee and Gu-won's relationship finally blossoms, Gu-won begins to experience a strange change in his powers — all amidst a larger looming threat.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Through the Shell
Episodes.Description: Upon discovering his fate, Gu-won tries to find another way to save himself. But just as he and Do-hee prepare their ritual, she becomes a target.

Episodes.Title: A Paradise of the Ominous
Episodes.Description: Gu-won finds his power restored after rescuing Do-hee from a sure death — but with side effects. With no time to waste, the two investigate the attack.

Episodes.Title: The Savior of Destruction
Episodes.Description: A dream of Gu-won's past life reveals his tragic connection to Do-hee. After the two hear of a death, their suspicions of the Noh family deepens.

Episodes.Title: The Past, the Original Sin
Episodes.Description: As Gu-won and Do-hee enjoy their bliss, he notices her unresolved trauma. The two later join Noh Suk-min for dinner, unaware of his true intentions.

Episodes.Title: Our Personal Hell
Episodes.Description: Gu-won comes to Do-hee's rescue after a frightening confrontation with Suk-min. But Suk-min's revelation about Cheon-suk leaves Do-hee harrowed.

Episodes.Title: The End of Fate
Episodes.Description: Police fails to find Suk-min's body, opening up a concerning possibility. Do-hee attempts to bury her feelings after Gu-won disappears without a trace.

Episodes.Title: Our Personal Heaven
Episodes.Description: Do-hee finds herself catatonic after her loss. Desperate for Gu-won's return, she makes a Christmas wish for her love — which Noh Suk-nyeo hears.

Entries.Title: Crash
Entries.Description: Insurance Investigator Cha Yeon-ho (Lee Min-ki) is accidentally caught up by the Traffic Crime Investigation Team (TCI) during a "Car Fraud" gang bust.  During questioning he shares his case records of a possible Vehicular Serial Murder case with Lieutenant Min So-hee (Kwak Sun-young).  So-hee gets personally involved after she finds out an acquaintance may have been a victim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Insurance Investigator Cha Yeon-ho (Lee Min-ki) is accidentally caught up by the Traffic Crime Investigation Team (TCI) during a "Car Fraud" gang bust.  During questioning he shares his case records of a possible Vehicular Serial Murder case with Lieutenant Min So-hee (Kwak Sun-young).  So-hee gets personally involved after she finds out an acquaintance may have been a victim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Killer Jung Ho-kyu (Bae Yoo-ram) plots his revenge against Jo Seok-tae (Lee Do-goon) for aiding Lt. Min So-hee.  Investigator Cha Yeon-ho obtains damaging evidence against Ho-kyu. Yeon-ho gets labeled as a whistle blower and quits his job. Capt. Jeong Chae-man (Heo Sung-tae) of TCI hires him into the team as a Lieutenant due to his investigative expertise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: TCI’s investigation into ghostly apparitions causing vehicular accidents uncovers a multiparty Car Scam Ring affiliation.  So-hee’s father, Min Yong-gun (Yoo Seung-mok), shares some of her background story with Yeon-ho.  Yeon-ho and So-hee go undercover as husband and wife.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The TCI investigates the case of a woman jumping from a car.  The Joint Investigative Unit moves to Namgang Police Station and takes over TCI’s case. Cha Yeon-ho is disgraced when a culprit gets away. So-hee decides to give him personal training in the finer arts of police arrest techniques.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The Hit and Run Case sheds light on a Car Thief and Serial Rapist case.  Mysterious envelopes related to Cha Yeon-ho’s tragic past traffic accident appears.  Min So-hee may be a little over zealous in the police arrest techniques training. Yeon-ho confronts Deputy Commissioner Pyo Myung-hak (Heo Jung-do) who investigated his case in the past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeon-ho is interrogated in regards to his past vehicular homicide case.  When Director General Lee Tae-joo (Oh Eui-sik) of the Joint Task Unit withholds information from his team and the TCI, they go to the aid of TCI.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Pyo Myung-hak is promoted to Commissioner General.  TCI’s investigation into a car carrier trailer rollover case finds that it was malicious and caused the death of a man driving home. Yang Jae-young (Heo Ji-won), the son of a former gangster, is murdered. Eo Hyeon-gyeong (Choi Moon-hee) meets Woo Dong-gi’s (Lee Ho-cheol’s) father, Woo Gil-soon (Joo Hyun).

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: TCI reveals a serial pattern in the Car Carrier Trailers Rollover Case which affected prior truck drivers for CY Logistics.  Woo Gil-soon was one of them.  Truck driver Han Kyung-soo (Han Sang-jo) confides the names of the individuals related to Cha’s past accident and that all had received threatening mail.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: TCI is assigned the Yang Jae-young Murder Case.  Min Yong-gun (Yoo Seung-mok), So-hee’s father, gets involved in an accident while chasing a Hit and Run driver.  Evidence leads to Pyo Jung-wook (Kang Ki-doong), the Commissioner General’s son. Yeon-ho shares his knowledge of his accident from 10 years prior with So-hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeon-ho finds out that Kim Hyun-min (Kim Dae-ho), the National Forensic Service analyst is the culprit behind the threatening envelopes. Pyo Jung-wook seeks the help of former gangster Yang Seok-chang (Lee Yoo-joon), Chairman of YSC Group. Han Kyung-soo confesses who the actual culprits were in Yeon-ho's vehicular homicide case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: TCI succeeds in capturing the real culprits of the 10 year vehicular homicide,  car carrier and the Hit and Run cases.  During Pyo Jung-wook’s trial, Commissioner Pyo is also implicated and arrested. Conniving Lee Tae-joo is promoted to Chief Superintendent. Rather than being promoted the team is dissolved and transferred. Cha Yeon-ho is sent to remote Hwapyeong island.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: When a local Inn Keeper’s daughter disappears Cha Yeon-ho reaches out for help.  The old TCI gang takes vacation to assist him. The team is finally promoted with exception of Chief Jeong who had rendered his resignation.  When Chief Justice Shin So-jung (Park Ji-young) is promoted to Director National Office of Investigation, she seeks out Chief Jeong to reestablish the TCI.

Entries.Title: My Happy Ending
Entries.Description: Due to the release of a new product, Jae-won stays in the office by herself till late at night when her longtime stalker barges into the office, trying to attack her. Later, Jae-won finds out the stalker’s identity. Nam Tae-ju, an insurance investigator, tells Jae-won that they’re suspecting Jae-won’s stepfather for her mother’s death. Meanwhile, Jae-won sees a suspicious message on her husband’s phone, only to find out later that he is cheating on her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Due to the release of a new product, Jae-won stays in the office by herself till late at night when her longtime stalker barges into the office, trying to attack her. Later, Jae-won finds out the stalker’s identity. Nam Tae-ju, an insurance investigator, tells Jae-won that they’re suspecting Jae-won’s stepfather for her mother’s death. Meanwhile, Jae-won sees a suspicious message on her husband’s phone, only to find out later that he is cheating on her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jae-won wakes up at the hospital after the incident. Because her company is launching a new product soon and she doesn’t know who the attacker is, she decides to let it go for now. But since she can’t trust the people around her, she asks Tae-ju to look into them. She feels sorry for suspecting her father, but regarding her husband, she becomes more certain about him having an affair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Teo tells Yoon-jin that he saw her with Soon-young and that she should stop developing the relationship further. Jae-won finds out that her dad used the insurance proceeds to pay off her late mother’s gambling debt. Teo restores the recording of the night Jae-won was attacked and finds out who the perpetrator is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Teo goes to confront the stalker who attacked Jae-won. But before Teo meets him, the stalker gets in an accident and becomes unconscious. Teo tries to find out who is behind the stalker, and Jae-won looks for Chi-young, Soon-young’s twin brother. She thinks that his existence is the only explanation for what has been happening to her lately. However, the investigation leads to another mystery.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Soon-young admits to dating Yoon-jin, and he asks for a divorce. He demands the custody of A-rin, but Jae-won refuses. Jae-won finds out that Yoon-jin has been picking A-rin up from her kindergarten from time to time. Yoon-jin’s portrait unveiling ceremony is held, and Jae-won prepares a special gift for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jae-won decides to get a divorce, but she can’t give up the custody. However, Soon-young is most likely to take the custody because he spent more time with A-rin. To turn the table around, Jae-won frames Soon-young for leaking confidential documents. While doing so, Jae-won notices that she also has a critical weakness. Meanwhile, Teo continues to investigate and find out who tried to kill Baek Seung-kyu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Soon-young recalls the day he got an email that revealed A-rin is not his biological daughter. After Jae-won realizes the reason behind Soon-young’s affair, she apologizes, but he doesn’t accept her apology. Jae-won decides to accept Soon-young’s terms and give up on A-rin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jae-won acts like a different person as if she had forgotten everything. Yoon-jin tries to make use of the situation, but Soon-young tells her to stay away from Jae-won. Soon-young takes Jae-won’s medicine pills to the doctor to find out what they are for. Meanwhile, Soon-young looks to find A-rin’s biological father with Teo's help, and Tae-ju meets Yoon-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jae-won’s father learns from Yoon-jin that Soon-young cheated on Jae-won. Outraged, he demands to know what Soon-young plans to do with Jae-won, and they both decide to keep Jae-won in the dark. Soon-young finds out who A-rin’s biological father is and what happened with Jae-won seven years ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jae-won is accused of killing Soon-young and gets arrested. Circumstantial evidence points to Jae-won as the killer, but the police can’t find the crucial evidence to indict her. She gets freed for lack of evidence and goes to her father’s place to rest and avoid reporters. Meanwhile, Chairman Kwon called for a stockholders' meeting to dismiss Jae-won from the CEO position.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jae-won and her father decide to send A-rin to America for her safety. Jae-won gets released from the mental institute and starts collecting evidence to prove who truly killed Soon-young. Meanwhile, Jae-won gets her hand on the data to prove that Kim Sang-bum manipulated the clinical test.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Jae-won is discharged, and she starts to put her plan into action. She visits Dereve and tells Yoon-jin that she will eventually get to her. Detective Oh Soo-jin looks into Soon-young’s case, and she notices that something is off. Jae-won goes to see Young-ik and tells him to choose the one that he wants to protect, his ministership or his daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Kwon Young-ik tries to kill Jae-won with a pesticide, just like he did with Soon-young. Teo comes to the rescue, and Jae-won barely manages to survive. At the parliamentary inspection of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, Jae-won reveals that Kwon Young-ik is responsible for her kidnapping and Soon-young’s murder. Kwon Young-ik gets arrested, but Jae-won doesn’t feel like it’s over.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Yoon-jin finds Seung-kyu who has been hiding from her. She fails to persuade him to side with her, and she kills him without hesitation. She frames his murder to Tae-ju, and Tae-ju goes off the grid. Meanwhile, Jae-won tries to find people who know about her mother’s past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Yoon-jin decides to get rid of Nam Tae-ju so he won’t be able to reveal the last card he has on her. However, her plan fails, and Nam Tae-ju appears in court to take the witness stand. Jae-won gets her hand on the video and tells Yoon-jin to come clean. When Yoon-jin refuses, Jae-won decides to use Nam Tae-ju to get her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yoon-jin takes A-rin, and everyone looks for them. Jae-won finds A-rin safe at home, and she asks her father to live with them together. A year later, Jae-won works as a freelance designer, and Teo becomes the CEO of Dereve. While doing so, Jae-won confronts her past and the resentment that has been following her to move on.

Entries.Title: A Good Day to be a Dog
Entries.Description: Hae-na has a crush on one of the male teachers at her school. After a few drinks at a get-together with the teachers, she discloses her feelings to him. However, after she kisses him, she realizes it's Seo-won, the man she can never get close to.

Episodes.Title: The Curse Begins
Episodes.Description: Hae-na has a crush on one of the male teachers at her school. After a few drinks at a get-together with the teachers, she discloses her feelings to him. However, after she kisses him, she realizes it's Seo-won, the man she can never get close to.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Witness
Episodes.Description: Hae-na begs Seo-won for another chance to go on a date with Bo-gyeom and him as a group to lift the curse. Therefore, Hae-na, Seo-won, Bo-gyeom, and Chae-a end up going on a double date to play a room escape game. Seo-won tries to leave for the day, but Hae-na has to stall time until midnight.

Episodes.Title: Keeping His Secret
Episodes.Description: Hae-na finds out that Seo-won is afraid of dogs. It complicates things as she has to get a kiss from him while she’s changed to a dog. The vice principal brings his dog to work, making Seo-won panic. Hae-na secretly helps Seo-won so that no one finds out about his secret fear of dogs. Meanwhile, Yul witnesses Hae-na transforming into a dog.

Episodes.Title: Overcoming Your Fear
Episodes.Description: Hae-na decides to ask Yul’s help and let her into his place while Seo-won is asleep. She kisses him while she’s in her dog form, but the curse doesn’t get lifted. Later, Hae-na finds out that Seo-won has to be conscious when she kisses him for her curse to be lifted. To do that, she decides to help Seo-won overcome his fear of dogs first.

Episodes.Title: Overcoming Trauma
Episodes.Description: Seo-won witnesses Ji-won getting bullied by her friends. To secure the evidence of bullying, Hae-na steals the bully’s phone while she’s transformed into a dog. An anti-bullying committee meeting is held to punish the bully, Jae-hee. To take revenge, Jae-hee decides to falsely accuse Seo-won of sexually harassing her.

Episodes.Title: The Transfer Student
Episodes.Description: A new student, Ji-a, transfers to Garam High School, and she turns out to be a shaman. She notices a different energy around Hae-na and Bo-gyeom. Hae-na fails to kiss Seo-won, so she has to seek her chance during the school trip. Meanwhile, some of the students sneak out at night, so Hae-na ends up going outside to look for them, risking herself to be exposed.

Episodes.Title: The Confession
Episodes.Description: Yu-na’s ex-boyfriend posts Hae-na’s secret online. Eun-hwan, who used to bully Seo-won in high school, sees the post and covers the story. Hae-na’s mom finds out about her transformation and demands to know who Hae-na’s boyfriend is. Hae-na decides to tell the truth to Seo-won and ask for his help.

Episodes.Title: The Threat And Revelation
Episodes.Description: Kang Eun-hwan blackmails Hae-na, saying he’d expose her secret unless she gives him all her savings. Upon hearing what Eun-hwan did, Hae-na's parents invade his place and find the recordings and photos he took of Hae-na. After seeing what Kang Eun-hwan posted online, Seo-won goes to see him, but he gets tied up instead.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Dates
Episodes.Description: Hae-na and Seo-won start dating officially, but they can’t show it at school because of the recent PDA incident between the teachers at a neighboring school. Although Hae-na and Seo-won try to be subtle at school, a few people notice a romantic vibe between them. Meanwhile, Ji-a does a card reading for Bo-gyeom and finds out who he truly is.

Episodes.Title: The Unknown Story
Episodes.Description: The mountain spirit saves Lady Han who was being chased by government officers. During the chase, the baby in Lady Han’s womb dies, leaving her in despair. Mak-soon, Lady Han’s servant, stays by her side and looks after her. The mountain spirit and Lady Han grow closer as they spend more time together. One day, the mountain spirit senses swordsmen in his mountain searching for Lady Han.

Episodes.Title: The Reason They Were Cursed
Episodes.Description: Hae-na’s uncle, Dong-chul, comes back to his human form. Hae-na’s family finds it strange that his curse got lifted when he hadn’t gotten a kiss. Bo-gyeom reveals himself to Hae-na and tells her that he was the one who put the curse on her family. Then he goes on to tell her that he’ll lift the curse only if she gives up her love for Seo-won.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Memories
Episodes.Description: Instead of Seo-won's memories, Hae-na's memories of him get erased, making Seo-won despair. Seo-won does his best to win Hae-na's heart again, but it doesn't go as well as he expected. However, Seo-won finds out that Ji-a still has memories of him and Hae-na dating. Meanwhile, Ji-a visits the mountain she died in her past life, which upsets Bo-gyeom.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: Hae-na keeps getting reminded of the memories she had with Seo-won. After Seo-won kisses her, Hae-na becomes sure that she and Seo-won shared certain memories. The mountain spirit finally realizes what happened to Cho-young and that he was mistaken all this time. He decides to return the memories to Hae-na.

Episodes.Title: The Birthday Present
Episodes.Description: After finding out everything about the curse and their past, Hae-na and Seo-won realize how they feel about each other. One year has passed, and Seo-won’s birthday is only ten days ahead. Hae-na wants to give him a present that is unexpected but meaningful. She prepares a special present and plans to give it to Seo-won at the school festival. However, an uninvited guest appears at the school.

Entries.Title: Doona!
Entries.Description: College student Lee Won-jun moves into a sharehouse, and meets a beautiful yet strangely familiar housemate — but they get off on the wrong foot.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Twist
Episodes.Description: College student Lee Won-jun moves into a sharehouse, and meets a beautiful yet strangely familiar housemate — but they get off on the wrong foot.

Episodes.Title: Getting to Know Each Other
Episodes.Description: Gradually, Lee Doona gets acquainted with Won-jun’s social circle. He later celebrates Doona's birthday, attempting to get to know her better.

Episodes.Title: Spring Breeze
Episodes.Description: Alone in her room, Doona feels unsafe — like she's being watched. Won-jun and Kim Jin-ju go out to see the cherry blossoms, but it starts to pour.

Episodes.Title: The Unexpected
Episodes.Description: Won-jun and Doona grab a late-night meal, experiencing their first paparazzi moment. Much to his disdain, Won-jun accidentally reunites with an old foe.

Episodes.Title: Meaningless Kiss
Episodes.Description: A confused Won-jun confronts Doona about the sudden kiss. New housemates move into the sharehouse, making the place livelier than ever.

Episodes.Title: Twilight Zone
Episodes.Description: Doona secretly visits Dream Sweet’s showcase event. Later, she invites Won-jun on a spontaneous trip to her childhood home.

Episodes.Title: Clear the Air
Episodes.Description: After the return of a person from her past, Doona makes a rash decision. Won-jun later confronts Doona in a moment of pain and frustration.

Episodes.Title: Typical and Ordinary
Episodes.Description: As Won-jun and Doona's relationship flourishes, a chance at a comeback comes knocking on Doona's door — but so do the tough choices.

Episodes.Title: Doona!
Episodes.Description: Won-jun moves into a new apartment and focuses on his studies. Meanwhile, Doona's career soars as she finds newfound confidence.

Entries.Title: Good Partner
Entries.Description: It’s Yu Ri’s first day at Law Firm Daejeong, 1 of Korea’s top 3 law firms. She thought she’d be joining the corporate department, but instead, she was assigned to the divorce department. Eun Kyung, the nation’s divorce attorney, instantly knows that Yu Ri isn’t the right material for a divorce attorney. However, Yu Ri tries to win the case in her own way.

Episodes.Title: Divorce Attorney
Episodes.Description: It’s Yu Ri’s first day at Law Firm Daejeong, 1 of Korea’s top 3 law firms. She thought she’d be joining the corporate department, but instead, she was assigned to the divorce department. Eun Kyung, the nation’s divorce attorney, instantly knows that Yu Ri isn’t the right material for a divorce attorney. However, Yu Ri tries to win the case in her own way.

Episodes.Title: Two Women
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri’s straightforward nature struggles to comprehend some of the methods Eun Kyung employs. She is particularly shocked when she sees Eun Kyung persuading her clients to prioritize economic benefits over child custody. To Eun Kyung, who possesses far more experience than a novice, Yu Ri is just a rookie in the big leagues. What astonishes Yu Ri even more is Eun Kyung's reaction after she reveals a little secret she’s discovered.

Episodes.Title: From Family To Non-family
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri is surprised to hear that Eun Kyung doesn’t want to divorce Ji Sang even after finding out about his affair with Sa Ra. Yu Ri finally starts a session with a client on her own and gets her first case. However, the client decides to drop the lawsuit. Yu Ri decides to quit working for the divorce team.

Episodes.Title: A Show
Episodes.Description: Eun Kyung asks Yu Ri to represent her for her divorce case against Ji Sang. Eun Kyung sends a letter of complaint to Sa Ra, letting everyone in the office know that she was involved in an unsavoury incident. Rumours about Eun Kyung and Ji Sang’s divorce circulate, but Eun Kyung doesn’t even bat an eye.

Episodes.Title: Office Husband
Episodes.Description: Ji Sang secretly leaks to a reporter that Eun Kyung might have an office husband and that she had an affair before him. Yu Ri decides to hear whether Eun Kyung and Woo Jin had an affair or not. Yu Ri convinces Eun Kyung to settle, but Eun Kyung doesn’t give in. Meanwhile, Yu Ri comes up with a brilliant idea to change the public’s opinion of Eun Kyung.

Episodes.Title: Qualifications To Be A Parent
Episodes.Description: The first hearing of Eun Kyung and Ji Sang’s divorce trial begins, and neither side wants to give up the custody of Jae Hui, their daughter. Jae Hui misunderstands Eun Kyung’s intention and thinks she wants to let her live with her father. Meanwhile, Yu Ri takes on a case of a couple who want to give up their custody.

Episodes.Title: In The Name Of Mother
Episodes.Description: As soon as Sa Ra gets promoted to chief manager, she gets dismissed from the law firm. Ji Sang tells Sa Ra that he has no intention of marrying her even if he gets divorced, which leaves her devastated. Meanwhile, Yu Ri’s stepmom comes to see Eun Kyung and threatens her to fire Yu Ri.

Episodes.Title: That's How Fatherhood Begins
Episodes.Description: Sa Ra is pregnant with Ji Sang’s child. However, Ji Sang’s lawyer advises him to abandon Sa Ra to win custody of his daughter. Sa Ra secretly puts the ultrasound picture of her baby in Jae Hui’s room, and Jae Hui eventually sees it. Meanwhile, Jae Hui finally meets the family investigator.

Episodes.Title: A Half Apology
Episodes.Description: Eun Kyung finds out that Jae Hui knew about her dad’s affair with Sa Ra even before she did. Ji Sang breaks up with her after hearing what Sa Ra did to Jae Hui. Eun Kyung becomes emotional after finding out about Sa Ra’s pregnancy and what she did to Jae Hui. Hence, Yu Ri looks for a way to calm her down.

Episodes.Title: A Messed Up Story Or The Final Chapter
Episodes.Description: Jae Hui confides in Yu Ri that she wishes her parents’ divorce trial to end soon so that everyone can move on. She also chooses to live with Eun Kyung instead of her father and lets him know how much his lies hurt her. Meanwhile, Sa Ra miscarries her baby, and her relationship with Ji Sang ends.

Episodes.Title: Absence
Episodes.Description: Mr. Oh suggests Eun Kyung to go on a vacation and resign once she returns. Eun Kyung decides to go on a trip with Jae Hui, but things don’t go too smoothly. The Divorce Team gets twice as busy with Eun Kyung gone. Meanwhile, Yu Ri takes on a case and solves it on her own for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Decision Closing Argument
Episodes.Description: Daejeong signs an MOU with Chun Medical Foundation and takes a divorce case from its chairman, Chun Hwan Seo. Mr. Oh assigns the case to Yu Ri instead of Eun Kyung, and Yu Ri learns from him that he intends to fire Eun Kyung soon. Meanwhile, Eun Kyung finds out that Woo Jin will become the managing partner of Daejeong.

Episodes.Title: Resolution
Episodes.Description: Chun Hwan Seo calls Eun Kyung to his house, and she finds his wife unconscious on the floor. Yu Ri, who was waiting outside the house, calls the police when she doesn’t hear from Eun Kyung. Meanwhile, Woo Jin comes up with a plan to deal with the mess Chun Medical Foundation put Daejeong into.

Episodes.Title: The Skill of Fighting
Episodes.Description: Eun Kyung decides to leave Daejeong and open up her own law firm. Although she starts out with a big ambition, it doesn’t turn out as well as she expected it to be. Yu Ri is given a choice to switch teams, but she hesitates. A new client visits Eun Kyung, but she sends her to Yu Ri, and Yu Ri does the same for Eun Kyung.

Episodes.Title: Honesty Or Truth
Episodes.Description: Eun Kyung realises that Yu Ri is the opposing counsel of her new client. They meet up to discuss a settlement, but they fail to find the middle ground. Eun Ho decides to leave Daejeong after much consideration and joins Eun Kyung’s new firm. After Eun Ho leaves the firm, Yu Ri realises how much he means to her.

Episodes.Title: Making A Choice The Right One
Episodes.Description: A year passes and Oh Dae Gyu's wife, Park Ae Yeon, files for divorce at Law Firm Daejeong, and Woo Jin assigns Yu Ri to take the case. Flabbergasted at facing his own company against him, Dae Gyu asks Eun Kyung to represent him. As Yu Ri and Eun Kyung try to settle outside the courtroom, Dae Gyu has a sudden change of heart. Meanwhile, Eun Kyung thinks of letting Jae Hui spend time with Ji Sang.

Episodes.Description: Desperate for a reunion, Hwang Geum-ju seemingly finds her long-lost daughter. After discovering the truth, Gang Nam-soon prepares for her trip to Korea.

Episodes.Title: Gangnam, Here I Come
Episodes.Description: Nam-soon begins her search for her parents in Korea but experiences some roadblocks. Geum-ju suspects something's off with her newfound daughter.

Episodes.Title: Three Generations
Episodes.Description: The incident at the Han River puts a spotlight on Nam-soon. As Kang Hee-sik spends more time with Nam-soon, he connects the dots about her family.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: After a dramatic reunion, Nam-soon becomes closer to her family. As Hee-sik continues to investigate a drug case, Nam-soon lends her assistance.

Episodes.Title: Vigilante of Seoul
Episodes.Description: As Nam-soon assists Hee-sik in his drug investigation, she has a run-in with the ominous Ryu Si-o. Ri Hwa-ja plots her revenge against Nam-soon.

Episodes.Title: Mystery X
Episodes.Description: Hee-sik witnesses the jarring effects of the drug when it strikes his team leader. Nam-soon's search for evidence garners attention from foes.

Episodes.Title: Moonbow
Episodes.Description: Geum-ju pays a strategic visit to Si-o, who has his own motives. During a birthday dinner, Nam-soon's family questions her growing kinship with Hee-sik.

Episodes.Title: Light and Shadow of Gangnam
Episodes.Description: Hee-sik begins to worry about Nam-soon after Si-o promotes her into his inner circle. Geum-ju probes deeper into a suspicious businessman.

Episodes.Title: The Root of Vice
Episodes.Description: Nam-soon pulls off a bold heist, putting Si-o on high alert. During a tense meeting, Geum-ju challenges Si-o — who in return begins plotting his revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Stand-ins
Episodes.Description: Geum-ju falls victim to Si-o's attack but proves she's one step ahead of him. As Nam-soon finally tracks down the drugs, her brother succumbs to them.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Point
Episodes.Description: The drug infiltrates Nam-soon's family — prompting a search of the source and an antidote. A mourning Hee-sik furiously goes after Si-o's inner circle.

Episodes.Title: Diamond Cuts Diamond
Episodes.Description: Si-o learns of Geum-ju's ruse and decides to expand his target. As the drug case becomes more intense, Hee-sik asks Nam-soon to move in with him.

Episodes.Title: Save the Sea Hares
Episodes.Description: To find out Nam-soon's identity, Si-o narrows down his search and goes after her family. Hee-sik faces harsh discipline after news of the drug goes wide.

Episodes.Title: Forewarned Bloodbath
Episodes.Description: Si-o vows revenge after discovering the truth about Nam-soon. While Hee-sik continues his investigation, Nam-soon and her family go on a trip to Busan.

Episodes.Title: Strong Girl Nam-soon
Episodes.Description: Mourning the loss of Hwa-ja, Nam-soon directly challenges Si-o. But he refuses to lose, forcing her to endure incredible pain to save her adopted mother.

Episodes.Title: In the Name of Love and Justice
Episodes.Description: With Nam-soon on the brink of death — Hee-sik rushes to find an antidote. Nam-soon faces Si-o once again but witnesses a surprising turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Wan-soo refuses to divorce Yongkook, while Tae-ra stands firm beside him. Tensions escalate as the day of the Hwain Group family's photoshoot nears. During the photoshoot, Miran replaces Wan-soo's deceased son with Yongkook's illegitimate child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Do-yoon worries for Wan-soo's safety as she holds a press conference regarding Hwain Group. He warns that the shooter who targeted her in Manila is within Hwain Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5

Episodes.Title: Episode 10

Episodes.Title: Things you only learn with time...

Meanwhile, Ju-won's mother reminds Yoon-seo of the promise she had made her, and Yoon-seo's brother gets into trouble at school for school bullying.

Episodes.Title: The Business Trip
Episodes.Description: An unknown number keeps texting Yoon-seo's phone with messages only an ex-boyfriend would text, making her suspect Ju-won. When she confronts him about it, she makes a fool of herself. Meanwhile, the company's new venture in the vacation sector opens a hanok getaway where Yoon-seo's team and Ju-won go for a business trip.

Episodes.Title: The Anonymous Texter
Episodes.Description: Ju-won leaves his family and shows up at Yoon-seo's door. His appearance exposes their relationship to the team, who even discover that their breakup was because of Ju-won's family's opposition, causing them to create an unbearable atmosphere for her in the office. Meanwhile, a crisis hits the Hanok Stay grand opening art exhibition, but Yoon-seo is away from her desk to handle it.

Episodes.Title: Can't Get Over Him
Episodes.Description: Yoon-seo struggles to clarify her relationship with Ju Won, even though she knows it's over. Ju-won's lingering feelings make it even harder for her. On top of that, Seong-min unexpectedly enters her life, sparking Ju-won’s jealousy. Feeling overwhelmed, she lashes out at Seong-min’s frivolous words and actions.

Episodes.Title: Another Tactic
Episodes.Description: While Yoon-seo and Seong-min seem to be getting closer, Ju-won becomes jealous and resorts to Si-won's advice of turning on his belligerent side. His sudden demeanor confuses Yoon-seo and frustrates her, angering her. But when she sees Ju-won with another woman, she is shocked by how flustered it made her.

Episodes.Title: The Marriage Proposal
Episodes.Description: Ju-won shows up at Yoon-seo's mother's funeral. He's there for her once again, and she cries in his solace. Then, he surprises her with a marriage proposal, leaving her speechless. As he waits anxiously for her answer, circumstances force him to go to Spain, but Yoon-seo rushes to see him at the airport as if she will lose him forever.

Episodes.Title: Seeking Happiness
Episodes.Description: Yoon-seo realises that before she can be honest about her relationship with Ju-won, there's something she needs to address first. Aware that the result might not be favourable, she decides to handle the situation on her own without involving Ju-won. Meanwhile, Si-won and Mi-jin are enjoying a wonderful night out together, but what starts as a moment of sincere honesty unexpectedly turns awkward.

Episodes.Title: A Cinderella Is Born
Episodes.Description: While Ju-won and Yoon-seo enjoy the outdoors, the shocking news of Sun-joo's husband's affair in New York spreads. To remedy the shattered image of the company, Sun-joo allows Yoon-seo to marry Ju-won. However, she will expose Yoon-seo's impoverished background to show the humility of the conglomerate family. Ju-won learns about this and then charges to confront his mother angrily, but Yoon-seo stops him.
