Entries.Title: The Third Marriage
Entries.Description: Go Eun's mother, Hae Il, leaves Go Eun and her father, Duk Soo, to find her own happiness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Go Eun's mother, Hae Il, leaves Go Eun and her father, Duk Soo, to find her own happiness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Face-to-face with her biological father at last, Da Jung learns the truth about her real name.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Se Ran cannot stand Da Jung and her father and decides to take revenge on them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Se Ran keeps approaching Sang Chul on purpose, and Sang Chul can't push her away.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Duk Soo is burdened by guilt for separating Da Jung from her mom and is eager to reunite them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Da Jung discovers she is pregnant, and Sang Chul is ecstatic. However, he has to break up with Se Ran.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Hae Il drinks with Ma Ri and frees her frustration, while Da Jung faces a hurdle in buying a food truck.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Hae Il gets into trouble, and Da Jung happens to witness it on her way to meet Se Ran.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Se Ran is pregnant with Sang Chul's baby, and Da Jung decides to work for Yo Han at his food truck to earn a living.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Se Ran rushes to Sang Chul's house in anger to expose the truth about their affair and her pregnancy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Se Ran lies to everyone that she is moving abroad, but instead, she stays close to Da Jung and stalks her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Se Ran sneaks into the hospital where Da Jung gave birth and switches their babies.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Se Ran goes to the Philippines after seeing Da Jung and Sang Chul embrace Song Yi in their arms.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Se Ran returns to Korea and catches the attention of Sang Chul, who regrets ever breaking up with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Se Ran secretly adds something to her drink, and Song Yi witnesses it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yo Han starts to work as a manager at Bobaejung, and Sang Chul thinks of divorcing Da Jung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Duk Soo sees Sang Chul and Se Ran together, while Bo Bae gets calls from people who claim to be her son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Duk Soo tells Sang Chul to end the affair and warns Se Ran he'll destroy her if she keeps seeing Sang Chul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Se Ran exposes her relationship with Sang Chul to Da Jung, and Da Jung can believe what she sees.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Da Jung wants to divorce Sang Chul right away but hesitates to leave for the sake of her daughter, Song Yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Da Jung finds out Se Ran had kept Sang Chul's baby, and Ae Ja tells Da Jung and Sang Chul to get a divorce.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Se Ran gets a DNA test before meeting Bo Bae and decides to visit the orphanage where her dad grew up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Se Ran buys some time from the truth getting out and sneaks into Da Jung's room to stop it completely.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Se Ran tries to switch the genuine DNA testing report headed for Madam Yoon with a fake one she made.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Bo Bae appoints Se Ran as CEO of Bobaejung, and Se Ran warns Yo Han to keep quiet about her affair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Se Ran tries to fire Da Jung on the spot, but Yo Han keeps getting in her way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Sang Chul frames Da Jung for having an affair with Yo Han, and Man Seok's brother visits the orphanage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Se Ran's uncle threatens Se Ran and forces her to pay him money and visit his mother at the care home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Duk Soo goes after Noel, thinking it's Hae Il, while Miss Kim reveals the truth about Madam Yoon's son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Young Sik threatens Se Ran for money again, and Duk Soo visits Noel's office to leave a note for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Noel decides to meet Duk Soo, and Da Jung cannot concentrate at work, thinking about meeting her birth mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Now that Duk Soo and Da Jung have failed to meet Hae Il, Duk Soo wants to look for his mother for Da Jung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Director Yeo discovers Se Ran's deception, and Yo Han draws Young Sik to Bobaejung to uncover the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Young Sik and Se Ran put Yo Han and Da Jung through torment, and Ae Ja gives Madam Yoon a picture of Man Seok.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Sang Chul and Ma Ri search for Da Jung, who didn't return home, and find her with Yo Han, both half naked.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Se Ran tries to frame Duk Soo as the murderer of her father, and Da Jung finds out about his past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Yo Han finds out Young Sik visited Sarang Orphanage, while Duk Soo takes Bo Bae's comb to compare their DNA.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Da Jung learns the truth behind Se Ran's revenge, and Duk Soo receives the DNA paternity test results.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Se Ran begs Duk Soo to bury the truth, but it only fuels Duk Soo's anger and determination to punish her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: When Da Jung sees Duk Soo in a coma, she painfully regrets blaming him for her miserable past. Yo Han is the only one by her side to lend her a shoulder. Meanwhile, Se Ran persuades Sang Chul to keep his mouth shut as they fearfully worry that their crime will come to light.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: When Se Ran and Ae Ja are about to take a load off their shoulders, they find out Yo Han is meeting the director of Sarang Orphanage. Furthermore, detectives take Da Jung to the station as they discover something at the scene.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Yo Han meets Young Sik to cut him off from Se Ran so he will not help her with her crime. He asks Young Sik for his statement that Kang Se Ran bribed him to lock Da Jung and him in the warehouse. Meanwhile, Se Ran realizes she left her trace at the crime scene, so she goes back to the park.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Se Ran gets reprimanded by Madam Yoon after getting blamed for the warehouse incident. She is stripped of her CEO title and put to work in the kitchen as Da Jung's helper. Meanwhile, Sang Chul finds Duk Soo's phone suspicious and tries to find out what Se Ran was trying to hide.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Da Jung has a hard time accepting Duk Soo's death. As she cleans his room, she finds the memorandum Sang Chul had written and realizes the date he signed it was the day Duk Soo passed away. Infuriated by what she knows, she interrogates Se Ran for more answers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Da Jung and Sang Chul arrive at the courthouse to finalize their divorce. When Se Ran hears about who got Song Yi's custody, she loses her mind. Meanwhile, Hae Il introduces Ji Hoon to Madam Yoon, and Madam Yoon visits Man Seok at the columbarium.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Je Guk is shocked to find out Yo Han has been visiting W Investments regularly, and he starts to keep an eye on him. Noel remembers Duk Soo calling her with a different name, Hae Il, and wonders who Hae Il is. Meanwhile, Da Jung shows the original photo of Man Seok without the mark on his shoulder to Bo Bae.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Se Ran looks for Duk Soo's phone, where the recording file is stored. Sang Chul is the one who kept Duk Soo's phone at home, but his mother throws it away, not knowing it has crucial evidence of Se Ran's crime. Meanwhile, Da Jung decides to look for her biological mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: Noel actively looks for anything that will help her remember her past. She hires a private investigator to look for someone named Hae Il or to find out if she was once Hae Il. Meanwhile, Da Jung searches for clues about her mother and visits a restaurant she vaguely remembers from her childhood memories.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: Sang Chul gets fed up with Se Ran for not introducing him to Madam Yoon. He takes the initiative and goes to Bobaejung by himself to meet her. Meanwhile, Da Jung gets lost in thought after finding a stuffed teddy bear with her mom's initials, H.I.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: The competition between Da Jung and Se Ran for a new menu begins. However, Se Ran cheats to get reinstated and fire Da Jung. Meanwhile, Since Se Ran is not willing to introduce Sang Chul and Ma Ri to Bo Bae anytime soon, Ma Ri decides to barge into Bobaejung first to meet Bo Bae.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: Da Jung wins the competition and becomes the vice CEO of Bobaejung. Now that Se Ran lost to Da Jung, even with all the benefits she had, she feels anxious as she is not the real granddaughter. Therefore, she comes up with a backup plan in case she gets caught.

Episodes.Title: Episode 52
Episodes.Description: With Sang Chul and Se Ran's belongings found at the park, Da Jung realizes that Duk Soo's death was not accidental. However, the evidence she has is not enough to reopen the case. Meanwhile, Noel remembers she had a daughter before she lost her memory.

Episodes.Title: Episode 53
Episodes.Description: Je Guk continues to believe there is a connection between Yo Han and W Investments and visits W Investments unannounced. Da Jung believes Ae Ja is up to something suspicious and stays up all night, keeping a close watch. Later, Madam Yoon learns about Se Ran and Ae Ja's misdeeds, and she punishes them severely.

Episodes.Title: Episode 54
Episodes.Description: Da Jung returns home to find her house ransacked. The only people she can think of responsible are Sang Chul and Se Ran. While picking up Song Yi, Da Jung fools Sang Chul into thinking Madam Yoon is anticipating to see him. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon visits Madam Yoon at Bobaejung and sees Se Ran.

Episodes.Title: Episode 55
Episodes.Description: Se Ran tells Madam Yoon that she did not know Baek Sang Chul was married and that he stalked her. Sang Chul decides to pretend to have Da Jung's dad's phone, but Se Ran soon figures out that he has no idea what's on the phone. Da Jung goes to her dad's old factory, but she passes out on the way. Chairman Wang finds her collapsed on the road, so he takes her to the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Episode 56
Episodes.Description: Ji Hoon asks Se Ran out after he finds out she is the granddaughter of Bobaejung's owner, and Se Ran takes this chance to get closer to him. Meanwhile, Da Jung visits Duk Soo's old office to look for witnesses at the park, and Noel also visits his office to get information on his whereabouts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 57
Episodes.Description: Yo Han comforts Da Jung as they are going through similar pain. Noel hires Sa Ri as her driver as he promises to help her find her daughter. After Bo Bae discovers that Se Ran had an affair with Da Jung's husband, she visits Sang Chul with Da Jung to hear the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 58
Episodes.Description: Madam Yoon orders Se Ran to pack her bags and leave, but Se Ran tells Madam Yoon about what drove her vindictive mind. Sang Chul gets a wake-up call when he learns Yo Han and Ji Hoon is Mr. Wang's nephew and son. Meanwhile, Yo Han tells Da Jung he's leaving Bobaejung and later drags her to try on a wedding dress that Ji Hoon sees.

Episodes.Title: Episode 59
Episodes.Description: After seeing Da Jung in the wedding dress, Ji Hoon falls head over heels for her and asks Yo Han for an introduction. However, Yo Han refuses. Meanwhile, Yo Han takes Hae Il's words as his chance to profess his genuine feelings for Da Jung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 60
Episodes.Description: Ji Hoon is glad to see Da Jung again at the hospital while helping Se Ran. Se Ran decides to invite Ji Hoon over for dinner to thank him for saving her life. Meanwhile, Da Jung finds a witness who happened to see Duk Soo at the park with Se Ran and Sang Chul, and Noel visits someone who might know about Go Eun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 61
Episodes.Description: Se Ran gets extremely jealous that Ji Hoon is interested in Da Jung, and Da Jung successfully makes a fool out of Se Ran. Da Jung meets Ji Hoon to return the gift, and Yo Han runs into them. Meanwhile, Da Jung finds out Song Yi's actual blood type at the hospital and gets a call from someone who witnessed Duk Soo's accident at the park.

Episodes.Title: Episode 62
Episodes.Description: Now that Da Jung finds out the truth about her father's death, Sang Chul begs her for forgiveness. On her way to a police station, she runs into Je Guk, who found her passed out and took her to the hospital. Meanwhile, Se Ran comes up with a plan to stop her from reporting, and Yo Han is worried as he cannot reach her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 63
Episodes.Description: After confronting Da Jung about the footage of Shin Duk Soo's death, Se Ran returns home in a state of bewilderment. When Yo Han can't reach Da Jung, he worries about her safety and visits her house. He sees Se Ran and Sang Chul together and suspects they did something to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 64
Episodes.Description: Da Jung is still out of reach, and Yo Han becomes even more worried about her. Sang Chul sneaks into Da Jung's house to retrieve her laptop but urgently has to hide after hearing Yo Han entering her house. Meanwhile, Yo Han learns about Da Jung's whereabouts from his secretary and heads to her last known location.

Episodes.Title: Episode 65
Episodes.Description: Even though Se Ran feels anxious about what she has done to Da Jung, she continues with her plan to win over Noel and Ji Hoon. Ji Hoon asks Yo Han about Da Jung, and Yo Han realizes Ji Hoon has feelings for her. Meanwhile, Da Jung stays quiet to get her revenge on Se Ran when she is letting her guard down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 66
Episodes.Description: Da Jung can speak well now but still cannot walk on her own. Yo Han finds crucial evidence of Da Jung's accident and reports it to the police. Therefore, Ae Ja gets arrested for kidnapping Da Jung. Meanwhile, Song Yi goes missing in the middle of the night, and Sang Chul and Ma Ri look for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 67
Episodes.Description: Yo Han feels bad that he cannot tell Da Jung about what happened to Song Yi. He confesses his feelings towards her and takes care of her. Meanwhile, Se Ran frames Sang Chul for a crime so that he will get arrested and stay away from her. At the station, Sang Chul runs into the driver who had hit Song Yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 68
Episodes.Description: Upon hearing news about Song Yi, Da Jung crumbles inside and thinks of joining her in the afterlife. However, Yo Han persuades her to change her mind. Meanwhile, Yo Han learns about Ji Hoon's marriage to Se Ran and tries to convince Je Guk to change his mind, but Je Guk tells him otherwise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 69
Episodes.Description: After receiving an anonymous parcel containing a voodoo doll, Se Ran asks Yo Han if he has heard anything about Da Jung. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon continues to long for women like Da Jung, and Je Guk returns from an overseas business trip and then makes a shocking announcement at Dream Food's anniversary party.

Episodes.Title: Episode 70
Episodes.Description: With Da Jung's comeback after two years, everyone is in shock and pain, especially Yo Han. Yo Han cannot believe what Da Jung has become and tries to stop her, but she is determined to get back at Se Ran on her own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 71
Episodes.Description: Yo Han goes on a trip with An Na and stays away from Je Guk and Da Jung. Da Jung feels sorry for Yo Han, but she promises herself she will not get distracted by him. Meanwhile, Sang Chul is released from prison and is about to expose Se Ran.

Episodes.Title: Episode 72
Episodes.Description: Je Guk appoints Da Jung as a director at Dream Food, and Da Jung becomes Se Ran's boss. Da Jung warns Se Ran that she will torment her all she can before reporting her for her crimes. Furthermore, Sang Chul visits Ji Hoon to reveal Se Ran's past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 73
Episodes.Description: Ji Hoon kicks Se Ran out of the house, and Da Jung warns Se Ran that this is just the beginning of her torture. Later, Da Jung learns that Se Ran is blood type AB while searching for the memory chip from two years ago. Meanwhile, Je Guk overhears Yo Han and Da Jung talking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 74
Episodes.Description: Da Jung's revenge is relentless. She attacks Se Ran every chance she gets, whether it's at home or the office. Meanwhile, Yo Han decides to move out of the house with An Na because of Je Guk's new wife. Later, when Da Jung picks up Song Yi's belongings from Sang Chul's house, Ma Ri and Sang Chul learn why Da Jung disappeared.

Episodes.Title: Episode 75
Episodes.Description: Yo Han sends the evidence of Se Ran's crime he gathered for years to Da Jung anonymously to help her in secret. Furthermore, he warns Se Ran to stay away from Da Jung. However, Se Ran plots another scheme to sabotage both Da Jung and Yo Han. Meanwhile, Noel barges into Je Guk's home and insists on staying at his place together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 76
Episodes.Description: Se Ran's mind gets blown when she sees Sang Chul and Ma Ri in front of the company with signs to protest. Meanwhile, Da Jung visits the ob-gyn where Song Yi was born and digs deeper into Song Yi's blood type. What she learns is shocking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 77
Episodes.Description: Da Jung gets new evidence in her hands sent by someone. The possibility that Song Yi isn't her child builds up, and she can't bear it much longer. She gets ready to sue Se Ran and requests a DNA paternity test with Song Yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 78
Episodes.Description: After learning that Song Yi isn't her child, Da Jung charges after Se Ran to kill her. However, Yo Han stops her and calms her down. With a new sense of revenge and Je Guk's approval, Da Jung reports Se Ran to the police. Meanwhile, Da Jung exposes what Se Ran did in front of the whole family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 79
Episodes.Description: Je Guk warns Yo Han to keep his hands off of Da Jung's matter, and Ji Hoon gets infuriated at Je Guk for using him for his business. As the family goes to ruin after Da Jung joins the family, Noel cannot stand her even more. Meanwhile, Se Ran goes through interrogation at the station, and Sang Chul and Ma Ri find out Song Yi was Se Ran's child through Da Jung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 80
Episodes.Description: Yo Han helps Da Jung find her biological daughter, and Je Guk happens to witness them together. Se Ran ends up in a detention center, and Ji Hoon and Sang Chul visit her. Meanwhile, Ae Ja comes over to Je Guk's home and begs for forgiveness, and Je Guk suggests a deal for her to get Se Ran out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 81
Episodes.Description: Se Ran endures prison life. However, it's too much to handle. When Ae Ja visits her, Se Ran shares her plans with her so she can overcome her situation. Meanwhile, Yo Han pleads with Da Jung that they shouldn't keep them a secret from Chairman Wang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 82
Episodes.Description: Chairman Wang overhears Yo Han and Da Jung talking and steps in. Yo Han takes him on face-to-face and fights over Da Jung, claiming that Je Guk was the first to step in between his relationship with Da Jung. Meanwhile, Se Ran's plan to get out of jail pushes Chairman Wang into a consequential predicament.

Episodes.Title: Episode 83
Episodes.Description: Se Ran has been cleared of charges and returns home from prison, which surprised everyone, especially Da Jung. Da Jung visits the adoption agency and finds out her biological daughter moved back to Korea from the US. Meanwhile, Noel discovers the truth behind Je Guk and Da Jung's marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 84
Episodes.Description: Je Guk tells Ji Hoon to hold off on divorce until Bo Bae reveals her recipe, and Bo Bae visits Je Guk to put an end to Se Ran and Ji Hoon's matter. Yo Han looks into how Se Ran managed to get discharged from prison. Meanwhile, Yo Han hears surprising news at the adoption agency.

Episodes.Title: Episode 85
Episodes.Description: Bo Bae advises Yo Han to tell Da Jung the truth, so he lets Da Jung know that An Na is her biological daughter. However, they need to keep it a secret to prevent Se Ran from harming her, as An Na is the crucial evidence of her crime. Meanwhile, Sang Chul comes to see Da Jung and asks about their daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 86
Episodes.Description: Hae Il shows Yo Han the marriage contract between Chairman Wang and Da Jung, and Yo Han begins to believe in Da Jung. Meanwhile, Chairman Wang warns Yo Han to stop spending time with Da Jung, and Da Jung considers breaking the marriage contract to be with An Na.

Episodes.Title: Episode 87
Episodes.Description: Yo Han and Da Jung confirm each other's love through a life-and-death situation. As Da Jung wishes earnestly for Yo Han's recovery, Chairman Wang notices her desperation and becomes angry. Meanwhile, Se Ran can't ignore Ji Hoon's suspicious letter, and Sang Chul and Ma Ri ask Se Ran about Da Jung's baby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 88
Episodes.Description: Da Jung realizes that Je Guk was the one who stabbed Yo Han. Despite Je Guk's warning, Yo Han waits for Da Jung to come back to him. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon receives another package, and Noel finds her painting in the garage and remembers something about her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 89
Episodes.Description: Ji Hoon is tortured by the parcels he has been receiving about Song Yi's hit-and-run accident, and this time, Se Ran receives a parcel named after Song Yi. Meanwhile, Ae Ja and Se Ran realize that Da Jung has already found her biological daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 90
Episodes.Description: As the blackmailer constantly threatens Ji Hoon, he confesses his crime to Je Guk to ask for help. At that moment, Da Jung walks into Je Guk's office. Meanwhile, Noel realizes that Je Guk had her paintings before they even met, and Da Jung collapses before the meeting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 91
Episodes.Description: After Yo Han and Da Jung reconcile the misunderstanding about Mount Nam, they rekindle their love for one another. Meanwhile, Da Jung misses an important meeting with a prospective business partner due to a drugging, and she suspects it is Se Ran behind the matter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 92
Episodes.Description: Yo Han and Da Jung secretly talk about how she can get away from Chairman Wang. Meanwhile, Sang Chul exposes what he and Se Ran did together to Ae Ja, and Se Ran learns that Yo Han adopted Song Yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 93
Episodes.Description: The blackmailer threatens Ji Hoon to bring a million dollars in a bag. Je Guk prepares the cash for him, and Ji Hoon drives off alone to meet him. Yo Han looks into what was in the flash drive that Ji Hoon received anonymously. Meanwhile, Sang Chul confirms that An Na is his biological daughter through a DNA test, and Se Ran is pregnant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 94
Episodes.Description: Da Jung and Yo Han catch the blackmailer and question him about the actual hit-and-run driver. He confirms that Ji Hoon was the driver who hit Song Yi and drove off, and Je Guk bribed his brother to take the fault instead. Meanwhile, Se Ran breaks into Sang Chul's apartment to find out about Da Jung's daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 95
Episodes.Description: Se Ran loses her mind when she finds out Song Yi died because of Ji Hoon, and Da Jung uses the hit-and-run accident to divorce Je Guk. Meanwhile, Sang Chul visits Je Guk to let him know the truth about An Na, and Se Ran packs up and leaves her house to go back to Bobaejung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 96
Episodes.Description: An Na disappears. Da Jung and Yo Han rush frantically to find her at Bobaejung. Sang Chul hears the news and shows up there as well. However, Da Jung and Yo Han unleash their anger at his atrocities while Chairman Wang keeps An Na hostage to keep Da Jung by his side. Meanwhile, Madam Yoon becomes suspicious after seeing what An Na drew.

Episodes.Title: Episode 97
Episodes.Description: Hae Il learns about the initials of the painting and information on who bought it at the gallery. After visiting the gallery, Hae Il searches her mind and finally regains her memories of her missing daughter. Meanwhile, Yo Han and Madam Yoon find something suspicious about An Na's drawing and ask her about it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 98
Episodes.Description: Noel resents Je Guk for lying about her past, including Duk Soo and her long-lost daughter. Yo Han tells Ji Hoon to turn himself in, but he ignores his warning and returns to his office. Meanwhile, Ae Ja gets caught stealing the photo of Man Seok in Bo Bae's office. Bo Bae finds it strange and gets an expert to investigate the photo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 99
Episodes.Description: Even when Je Guk is watching Da Jung closely, Yo Han and Da Jung secretly meet behind his back at the office. Noel finds out her daughter was sold to a diner, and Goeun Milling was bought by Je Guk. Meanwhile, Mi Soon, Bo Bae's secretary, steals Se Ran's toothbrush to do a DNA test but runs into Se Ran on her way out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 100
Episodes.Description: Bo Bae cannot believe the DNA test result that says Se Ran is not her granddaughter. She realizes Se Ran fabricated Man Seok's photo and replaced the DNA report with a forgery because she knew who her biological son was. Meanwhile, Je Guk threatens Young Sik to reveal the truth about Se Ran.

Episodes.Title: Episode 101
Episodes.Description: Da Jung suspects Se Ran has something to do with Madam Yoon collapsing when she sees her prescription bottle lying far away. Meanwhile, Se Ran and Ae Ja try to take as much money from Madam Yoon while she is unconscious in the hospital. However, they don't realize this is all part of Madam Yoon's ultimate plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 102
Episodes.Description: Hae Il learns more about the past and attempts to leave Je Guk's house. Da Jung and Yo Han believe they can get important clues to finding Madam Yoon's son from Kim Kkot Boon and search for her whereabouts. Meanwhile, Sang Chul tries to return the golden toad to Se Ran and learns about her pending divorce.

Episodes.Title: Episode 103
Episodes.Description: Sang Chul witnesses An Na with Duk Soo's phone and manages to take it from her. He uses the phone to bargain with Se Ran for money as it contains crucial evidence of her crime. As both Sang Chul and Yo Han threaten her with evidence, Se Ran is on the edge of her seat. Meanwhile, Ae Ja finds the soy sauce recipe that Bo Bae hid.

Episodes.Title: Episode 104
Episodes.Description: Ji Hoon decides to turn himself in for the hit-and-run accident as Da Jung advised, but Je Guk is completely against the idea. Se Ran discovers where Sang Chul left Duk Soo's phone to get repaired, so she heads to the repair shop, and Sang Chul goes after her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 105
Episodes.Description: Young Soo and Ae Ja get caught by Da Jung and Yo Han while trying to kidnap Bo Bae at the hospital. After Bo Bae wakes up, they look for crucial evidence of Se Ran's crime in Duk Soo's phone and realize that Duk Soo was Bo Bae's biological son. Meanwhile, Noel finds out her daughter, Go Eun, is alive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 106
Episodes.Description: Madam Yoon throws a celebration party for reuniting with her long-lost granddaughter at Bobajung. To take matters further, Madam Yoon tells Chairman Wang to divorce Da Jung with a threat that could demolish his business plans. Meanwhile, Se Ran gets interrogated at the police station, but without hard evidence, she may get released from police custody in 48 hours.

Episodes.Title: Episode 107
Episodes.Description: Hae Il learns that it was Ae Ja who sold Go Eun to the diner after overhearing Ae Ja, Se Ran, and a man arguing in front of Chairman Wang's house, and she almost faints. Meanwhile, Da Jung presses Chairman Wang for a divorce, but he adamantly refuses. Later, Ae Ja and Se Ran realize the situation between Hae Il, Da Jung, and Je Guk and plan to use it to get back on their feet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 108
Episodes.Description: When Noel hears that Da Jung was at the memorial hall, she realizes every hint about Go Eun is pointing back to Da Jung. She asks Yo Han about Da Jung's father to confirm she is her daughter. Meanwhile, Sang Chul tries to win Da Jung back, and Je Guk finds out Da Jung took a look at his secret ledger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 109
Episodes.Description: Noel threatens Je Guk to get a divorce with Da Jung, so he gets the paperwork ready. Se Ran hides Ae Ja at Je Guk's place without letting the family know, and Je Guk tells Ji Hoon to look into W Investments. Meanwhile, Noel cannot live with excessive guilt for not recognizing her daughter, Da Jung, sooner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 110
Episodes.Description: Yo Han finds Noel's note on her desk. He realizes she is Da Jung's biological mother and is about to take her own life. Meanwhile, Je Guk orders Sang Chul to tail Da Jung and get information from her, and Se Ran finds out where Da Jung's handbag with the USB flash drive is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 111
Episodes.Description: Se Ran learns that video evidence of Shin Duk Soo's death is on a flash drive hidden in the bag. She and Ae Ja rush to get their hands on it before Da Jung. However, Hae Il knows about it and tries to stall Se Ran from leaving, giving Da Jung and Yo Han a head start.

Episodes.Title: Episode 112
Episodes.Description: Yo Han learns it was his fault that Se Ran found out about the bag, and to make up to Da Jung for it, he takes the opportunity to set a trap for Se Ran and Ae Ja. Meanwhile, Se Ran uses Sang Chul to find out more about Chairman Wang's slush fund, not knowing that was what Da Jung and Yo Han wanted.

Episodes.Title: Episode 113
Episodes.Description: Yo Han blackmails Mr. Kim, Je Guk's assistant, to find out how to get into his storage full of slush funds. Da Jung and Yo Han plan to take Se Ran, Ae Ja, and Je Guk down at once. Meanwhile, Se Ran and Sang Chul get into Je Guk's storage, and Je Guk gets arrested for stock manipulation and keeping a slush fund.

Episodes.Title: Episode 114
Episodes.Description: When Sang Chul and Je Guk realize the warehouse turned out to be a fake, they take it out on Se Ran. Even when Se Ran explains that Da Jung and Yo Han set them up, they firmly believe it was her doings. At the same time, Yo Han tries to persuade Noel to reveal the truth to Da Jung. However, Da Jung finds the note at Noel's office and realizes that Noel is her biological mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 115
Episodes.Description: Se Ran and Ae Ja temper the ingredients at Bobaejung, so the restaurant gets suspended, and Da Jung compensates the customers. Now that Da Jung knows the truth, Noel musters up the courage and visits Da Jung to apologize for what she has done. Meanwhile, Je Guk finds out his assistant, Mr. Kim, was in touch with Yo Han.

Episodes.Title: Episode 116
Episodes.Description: Madam Yoon convinces Da Jung to let go of the past and reconcile with Hae Il, her mother, who is recovering in bed. Yo Han also persuades her to grab hold of the present and live with no regrets. After giving it some thought, Da Jung approaches Hae Il. Meanwhile, Da Jung and Yo Han learn that Se Ran is smuggling in diamonds and plan to stop her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 117
Episodes.Description: Se Ran gets furious as she loses the diamonds to Da Jung right before her eyes. To get back at Da Jung, she posts gossip about Da Jung's marriage, and therefore, the public starts to mock Da Jung and Yo Han. Meanwhile, Se Ran gets ready for her first fan meet, and Da Jung prepares a surprise for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 118
Episodes.Description: Se Ran gets humiliated on a massive scale at her fan meet, and the whole world knows about her fake academic background and work experience. Ji Hoon starts to doubt everything about Se Ran, including her pregnancy. Therefore, Se Ran quickly looks for a forged pregnancy journal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 119
Episodes.Description: Ji Hoon cut ties with Se Ran after Noel reveals her fake pregnancy. Je Guk kicks both Se Ran and Ae Ja out of his house and reports them to the police. Now that Se Ran is left with nothing, she heads over to Bobaejung to do anything she can to get back at Da Jung. Meanwhile, Je Guk looks into Mr. Jang, Yo Han's assistant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 120
Episodes.Description: Yo Han rushes to find An Na, and Da Jung stays behind in shock after receiving An Na's ransom call. Da Jung believes Ae Ja and Se Ran are behind An Na's kidnapping and trembles in fear they might hurt her. Meanwhile, as Se Ran and Ae Ja wait with An Na for the light of day, they tell An Na the shocking truth about her parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 121
Episodes.Description: An Na recovers in the hospital but isn't too happy seeing Da Jung. Yo Han learns that Je Guk knows he is the CEO of W Investments, but he doesn't falter and confronts Je Guk about it, telling him he will take back Dream Food that belonged to his late father. Later, Da Jung receives an urgent call and rushes to the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Episode 122
Episodes.Description: Ji Hoon gets into a car accident while driving Yo Han's car. At the hospital, Je Guk throws a fit at Yo Han for letting Ji Hoon drive his car, so Yo Han suspects Je Guk did something to his car. Furthermore, Ji Hoon is shocked when he finds out Je Guk tried to murder Yo Han.

Episodes.Title: Episode 123
Episodes.Description: Ji Hoon is upset that he got into this mess because of his father. Therefore, he crawls up to the top of the hospital to take his own life. Yo Han stops by to check up on him and realizes he is not in his room. Meanwhile, An Na is having a hard time after the kidnapping incident, so Da Jung takes her to see a doctor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 124
Episodes.Description: Yo Han tells Ji Hoon about his father's accident which Je Guk had planned to steal Dream Food. Ma Ri starts working at Je Guk's home and sees Ji Hoon in a wheelchair. Meanwhile, Sang Chul barges into Bobaejung to meet An Na and accidentally reveals that he is her biological father.

Episodes.Title: Episode 125
Episodes.Description: Mr. Kim returns to Je Guk for forgiveness. He claims to remain loyal to Je Guk and asks for a chance to redeem himself. Je Guk gives him one last chance and lets him go. Meanwhile, Se Ran decides to see Ji Hoon for her advantage, and later, Yo Han finds himself in trouble due to Mr. Kim's betrayal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 126
Episodes.Description: Da Jung realizes Yo Han is in danger and fears Je Guk put a hit on him. She storms to his house and begs him to let him go, but Je Guk denies having anything to do with Yo Han. Meanwhile, through Ma Ri's words, Da Jung learns Mr. Kim betrayed Yo Han and is keeping him hostage. She plans to use herself as bait and rescue Yo Han.

Episodes.Title: Episode 127
Episodes.Description: Now that Yo Han knows Je Guk has a paper company to steal slush funds, he needs to find evidence that proves Je Guk is hiding money in someone else's account. Meanwhile, Bo Bae barges into Je Guk's office to cancel their contract, and he reveals the truth behind Duk Soo's downfall.

Episodes.Title: Episode 128
Episodes.Description: After meeting Je Guk, Bo Bae lets Da Jung and Noel know that Je Guk set everything up to steal Noel and the company from Duk Soo. Da Jung is heartbroken as she was once married to a man who was involved in her parents' divorce. Before Je Guk moves the money from Danny Jung's account, Da Jung comes up with a plan to bring him down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 129
Episodes.Description: Da Jung disguises as Xiao Cheung and meets Je Guk to discuss his new project. Sang Chul wins the lottery, and Se Ran suggests he invest in Je Guk's resort business. Meanwhile, Noel visits Doctor Kim for treatment, and Doctor Kim notifies Je Guk secretly.

Episodes.Title: Episode 130
Episodes.Description: Chairman Wang springs a surprise visit to the construction site and almost catches Da Jung and Yo Han off guard. Ma Ri overhears Se Ran talking to Ji Hoon and learns she has been lying about her pregnancy and tells Sang Chul about it, shocking him. Meanwhile, Da Jung and Yo Han's plan to fool Chairman Wang goes smoothly.

Episodes.Title: Episode 131
Episodes.Description: Je Guk faces heat from all directions but thinks his tail is covered. However, during the shareholders' meeting, Yo Han exposes the true nature of his corruption that Je Guk can't escape. Meanwhile, Se Ran sneaks into the shareholders' meeting, where she learns the truth behind the incident from 26 years ago and is stunned.

Episodes.Title: Episode 132
Episodes.Description: Even though Se Ran realizes the person who murdered her father was Je Guk, she cannot accept it as she spent her whole life trying to get revenge on Duk Soo and Da Jung. Da Jung tells her to turn herself in for her crimes, but she has to get back at Je Guk first.

Entries.Title: HeartBeat
Entries.Description: Vampire Woo-hyeol has one desperate wish: to become human and experience heart-pounding love. He tried many ways to become human, but none of them worked. After hearing from a 1000-year-old cat that he can become human if he sleeps in a hawthorn coffin for 100 years, he enters the coffin for a lengthy slumber.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Vampire Woo-hyeol has one desperate wish: to become human and experience heart-pounding love. He tried many ways to become human, but none of them worked. After hearing from a 1000-year-old cat that he can become human if he sleeps in a hawthorn coffin for 100 years, he enters the coffin for a lengthy slumber.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: With only one day left in his 100-year goal, he fails to become a human being. He is even bitten by a woman, In-hae, causing him to faint. Yang-nam advises him to keep her by his side and watch her over, as she doesn't seem to be an ordinary person. Meanwhile, In-hae encounters a real estate scammer and gets involved in a chase to catch the fraudster, but finds herself in danger...

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: In-hae finds out that Woo-hyeol is a real vampire. However, what Woo-hyeol buys with her credit cards even makes her more shocked. She threatens to sell the mansion if Woo-hyeol can't repay his debt and starts living with him under a contract. Woo-hyeol reunites with two vampires named Sang-hae and Dong-seop in the second-hand market. They lament the world in which vampires are drained by humans.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The blood on In-hae's lip triggers a memory in Woo-hyeol, reminding him of Hae-sun. Woo-hyul wonders if In-hae is the reincarnation of Hae-sun. In-hae is concerned about her first kiss with Woo-hyeol and feels more uncomfortable seeing him, who is employed as a janitor at the school she works at. Yang-nam tells Woo-hyeol that if he drinks In-hae's blood, filled with love, he can become human.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Woo-hyeol strives to turn In-hae's blood into full-of-love, but she shows no interest whatsoever. To make matters worse, rumors spread within the school that Woo-hyeol and In-hae are dating, which resulted in In-hae losing her job. Feeling upset, In-hae drinks heavily and confides her past to Woo-hyeol, and his genuine reaction makes her heart pound.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: In-hae struggles to find a new job. Do-sik suggests In-hae start a guesthouse using her mansion. Although Woo-hyeol strongly opposes the idea at first, he eventually agrees because there is no other way for In-hae and Do-sik to become closer. As Woo-hyeol realizes Do-sik's affection for In-hae, he feels a pang of jealousy. Meanwhile, someone whom Woo-hyeol has longed for appears before him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Woo-hyeol is surprised to see Hae-won, who looks exactly like his past love, Hae-sun. He can't approach Hae-won because she doesn't seem to remember her past life. As In-hae feels sorry for Woo-hyeol, she invites Hae-won to a dinner for Woo-hyeol to spend some time with her. However, In-hae becomes anxious, thinking that Woo-hyeol's vampire identity might be revealed during dinner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Woo-hyeol and In-hae are forced to leave the mansion due to construction. Now that they are apart, they strangely think of each other more. However, Woo-hyeol starts experiencing physical symptoms and hears from Yang-nam that if he doesn't consume In-hae's blood, filled with love, he will die from it soon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Do-sik discovers that Woo-hyeol is a vampire and tests In-hae, who unexpectedly protects Woo-hyeol. Woo-hyeol, troubled by the fact that he needs In-hae's blood to survive, faces additional challenges when Hae-won becomes more affectionate towards him. Desperate to obtain In-hae's blood filled with love, Woo-hyeol's heart is tormented.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: In-hae cannot understand Woo-hyeol, who says he needs to have her blood filled with love. Woo-hyeol proposes a deal where, if In-hae provided him with her blood, he would leave the house. Meanwhile, Hae-won asks In-hae to throw a party to get closer to Woo-hyeol. Everything seems to go smoothly, but In-hae cannot shake off a sense of unease.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Woo-hyeol and In-hae develop strange feelings towards each other after the party. Do-sik, who realizes something is going on between them, tries to take them apart by letting In-hae know that Woo-hyeol is a vampire. However, In-hae takes Woo-hyeol’s side instead. In a drunken state, Hae-won calls Woo-hyeol, and while he's on his way to drop her off, he discovers a shocking truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: While nursing Woo-hyeol, In-hae and Woo-hyeol confirm their feelings for each other. At Gwang-ok's request, they spend time together while taking care of Min-jae. Meanwhile, Do-sik, who is holding hands with Man-hwi, begins to suspect Woo-hyeol of being a half-vampire. Upon realizing that Woo-hyeol is aiming for In-hae's blood to become human, Do-sik immediately sets out to chase after Woo-hyeol.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Woo-hyeol is unable to forgive himself for losing control due to his vampire instincts upon seeing In-hae's blood. As he suffers from the cruel fate that prevents him from being with In-hae, he decides to leave In-hae. Meanwhile, upon discovering that Woo-hyeol is the half-vampire he has been searching for, Do-sik orders Man-hwi to capture Woo-hyeol.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: In-hae's long-awaited father makes a return, but her emotional wounds make it difficult for her to accept him. Meanwhile, Woo-hyeol's health continues to deteriorate, deeply saddening Sang-hae and Dong-seop as they realize that time is running out for him. Meanwhile, as Man-hwi fails to capture Woo-hyeol, Do-sik takes matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: "Even when my heart doesn't race, it can hurt this much." Although Woo-hyeol left In-hae for her own good, the longing hasn't faded. In-hae also misses him and wanders in search of Woo-hyeol, who suddenly disappeared. At that time, Man-hwi visits the guest house, putting In-hae in danger. To make matters worse, rumors spread about a vampire living in the mansion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: As Woo-hyeol accepts the fact that there's not much time left for him, he decides to spend the remaining time with In-hae. Do-sik, upon finding out that Woo-hyeol is getting close to death, also becomes anxious. Will Woo-hyeol and In-hae be able to hold onto their love until the end?

Entries.Title: Tale of the Nine Tailed 1938
Entries.Description: Four months after Lee Rang’s death, Lee Yeon resumes to be the nine-tailed fox on the condition that Lee Rang reincarnates. Meanwhile, an uninvited guest steals the guardian stone, and disappears "into the cabinet." Lee Yeon jumps into the cabinet and finds himself standing in Gyeongseong in the year 1938. He then encounters Lee Rang, who immediately just charges at his brother, yelling "Die!"

Episodes.Title: Chapter 1: Brotherhood, 1938
Episodes.Description: Four months after Lee Rang’s death, Lee Yeon resumes to be the nine-tailed fox on the condition that Lee Rang reincarnates. Meanwhile, an uninvited guest steals the guardian stone, and disappears "into the cabinet." Lee Yeon jumps into the cabinet and finds himself standing in Gyeongseong in the year 1938. He then encounters Lee Rang, who immediately just charges at his brother, yelling "Die!"

Episodes.Title: Chapter 2: Beautiful "Mi"
Episodes.Description: After saving Lee Rang, Lee Yeon fails to return to the present, so he visits Taluipa of the 1930s, who asks him to work for her until the Gate of Time reopens. Under Taluipa's orders, both brothers board a train to find the Legendary Pipe. Inside the train is a woman who prepares to greet Lee Yeon, Shinju who devises an escape plan, and an hourglass that indicates the approaching overpass.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 3: Saetani
Episodes.Description: There's a "big rice chest" covered with amulets, and Moo-yeong appears before it. He is then seen carrying a blindfolded young girl, who removes her blindfold and chimes her bell saying, "Where are you? Found you!" Lee Yeon opens his eyes and meets her gaze, only to wake up screaming. That afternoon, after seeing Hong-joo holding a bouquet of flowers, everything goes black before his eyes...

Episodes.Title: Chapter 4: The Foundling
Episodes.Description: A strange basket appears in front of Myoyeongak. Inside it is a living, breathing baby with "7 red moles" on her forehead. Although both brothers secretly attempt to place the basket on someone else's doorstep, they return to find it sitting right where it was found?! Meanwhile, red-white mask steals from Gyeongseong’s gold mining royalties in search of the "golden ruler" that revives the dead.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 5: The Foundling II
Episodes.Description: Inside Myoyeongak, detectives, who're here for baby, are confronting Lee Yeon and Lee Rang. A scuffle breaks out, while Mi-ho innocently smiles within the bubbles. Meanwhile, Hong-joo arrives in Manchuria where she finds "Lee Yeon in 1938" drunk on opium. Lee Yeon calls for "Ah-eum," to which her face turns cold. Just as she turns to leave, Lee Yeon from 1938 calls out and hugs her from behind...!

Episodes.Title: Chapter 6: The Corner Game
Episodes.Description: A "red pouch" is placed on Myoyeongak's roof: Moo-yeong's invitation to a dangerous guest. Meanwhile, Jook-hyang notices one new gisaeng wearing a pair of "old straw shoes." That night, Eun-ho and the gisaengs play the "corner game" calling on corner ghosts. Just then, the candle burns out, and Eun-ho disappears. To get her back, the mountain gods and Shin-ju play the corner game once again...

Episodes.Title: Chapter 7: Jangsan Tiger
Episodes.Description: Lee Yeon and Moo-young get caught in an unknown act while searching for the Jangsan Tiger in the "Path of the Damned." They're tied up and had their throats slashed mercilessly, only to wake up and find that it was all for a TV series set. They are given a script titled "Jangsan Tiger's Bride." As they attempt to leave, they're surprised to see the female lead get out of a van. It's Hong-joo.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 8: Indigenous Gods
Episodes.Description: It's been days since Jangsan Tiger's uproar. Lee Rang remembers Moo-yeong's warning and heads to Myoyeongak. "Shinigami Mercenaries" arrive at Gyeongseong Station, and are ordered to capture "Joseon demons." Meanwhile, protesting indigenous gods go to Myoyeonggak. Hyunuiong looks troubled. Lee Rang changes his expression during a gambling event where the bet is on lifespan instead of money.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 9: Bando Hotel
Episodes.Description: Gyeongseong's indigenous gods vanished and died overnight! At Myoyeongak, Lee Yeon tells Hong-joo that he will take the treasures to the Bando Hotel. After a round of fist fights and drinks, Lee Yeon tells Moo-yeong the same thing. Meanwhile, Hong-joo bargains with the Chief Commissioner for the safety of Myoyeongak and her girls... All demons gather at the Bando Hotel to obtain the treasures.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 10: Shinigami Mercenaries
Episodes.Description: In the painting at Bando Hotel, Room 404, the three mountain gods face Ushiuchibo. At the snap of his finger, Hong-joo and Moo-yeong vomit blood. Lee Yeon searches for an antidote in the woods when he encounters an injured old man. The old man turns out to be Onyudo, a mercenary. As black smoke emerges from his mouth, something unbelievable happens. They switch bodies!

Episodes.Title: Chapter 11: Trap
Episodes.Description: Lee Yeon as Nyudo appears astounded that there are five mercenaries, not four. As he unwraps a piece of caramel, he calls for Oogama and Yuki to buy some time. Nyudo as Lee Yeon lures Hong-joo and Moo-yeong, and the guardian stone's whereabouts provoke them to fight. Meanwhile, Yeo-hee's breathing unstabilizes and axiousness permeates Room 302. Azalea determinedly approaches with a dagger...

Episodes.Title: Chapter 12: Joseon's Last Mountain God
Episodes.Description: In a room filled with opium smoke, Lee Yeon from 1938 starts after reading a letter. Yeo-hee and Jae-yoo got kidnapped last night. Lee Yeon meets the Chief Commissioner who proposes an exchange deal. Akira informs Hong-joo and Lee Rang that the one hostage who gets to live depends on them. The air is tense as Lee Rang's eyes shake at Hong-joo's words. That's when Lee Yeon bursts into the room...

Episodes.Title: Finding Your Ideal Type
Episodes.Description: After learning what Jin Woo's ideal type is, Ki Sub decides to reach his goal by the deadline.

Episodes.Title: The Contract That Started It All
Episodes.Description: Jin Woo accepts the contract proposed by Ki Sub and begins living with him for a week, and is surprised by Ki Sub's success in meeting the criteria of his ideal type, which he thought was impossible. On the other hand, Balg Eum is shaken by the appearance of In Ho, whom he had feelings for in high school, and after thinking about it, he coldly pushes him away.

Episodes.Title: My Ideal Type And You Who Suddenly Appear Unexpectedly
Episodes.Description: Jin Woo unexpectedly kisses Ki Sub. Frustrated that his first kiss didn't go well, he goes to the library to study and read romance books, when he meets Hye Jin, a woman who looks like her ideal type. Balg Eum succumbs to In Ho's enthusiasm and promises to go on only three dates with him, but...

Episodes.Title: Someone Who I Can Love
Episodes.Description: During their date, Jin Woo, who couldn't stop thinking about Ki Sub, evades Ki Sub's question about his relationship with Hye Jin. Worried about Jin Woo, Ki Sub is confronted by Hye Jin, who tells him to disappear for Jin Woo's sake. Meanwhile, Balg Eum and In Ho spend time alone at home.

Episodes.Title: Knowing One's Heart, Singing Words Of Love
Episodes.Description: After leaving Jin Woo's house, Ki Sub feels unwell and goes to the elementary school where his sister works. When Ki Sub finally realizes his feelings and goes to Jin Woo's house, Jin Woo isn't there. Balg Eum, upset that the second date didn't go as planned, became emotional, and the feelings he had kept hidden burst out...

Episodes.Title: The Gift I've Always Wanted To Receive
Episodes.Description: The two finally reunite. Clearing up their misunderstandings, they spend a pleasant night together at Jin Woo's family home. Learning about Jin Woo's childhood, Ki Sub decides to plan a surprise for him. The next day, deeply moved by the heartfelt surprise, Jin Woo finally makes up his mind...

Episodes.Title: Promise Of Love At First 'Sight'
Episodes.Description: Ki Sub mustered the courage to honestly express his feelings to his family to clear up unresolved issues. In an attempt to cheer up the despondent Balg Eum, they both volunteer to help with a countdown party. In Ho, upon learning Balg Eum's true feelings, also visits the shop to give a final farewell...

Entries.Title: Twinkling Watermelon
Entries.Description: Eun-gyeol and his family move into a new neighborhood. He meets a man who offers to teach him how to play the guitar, and Eun-gyeol works hard to learn it. As he deals with bullies at school, he practices playing the guitar until he is as good as the man who taught him. However, tragedy strikes, and he and his family are forced to move again.

Episodes.Title: Passion Is Born
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol and his family move into a new neighborhood. He meets a man who offers to teach him how to play the guitar, and Eun-gyeol works hard to learn it. As he deals with bullies at school, he practices playing the guitar until he is as good as the man who taught him. However, tragedy strikes, and he and his family are forced to move again.

Episodes.Title: Eun Gyeol Quits Music
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol tries his best to quit music, but it's not easy for him to do. He gets scouted to join SPINE9, an indie band in Hongdae. To make things worse, he finally gets his hands on the guitar promised by the Viva Music store owner. He is torn by which path to take and finds himself walking into a suspicious music store.

Episodes.Title: Seoul 1995
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol gets stuck in 1995 and doesn't know how to return to the present. What's worse is that he meets his young father, Yi-chan, who can talk and wants to start a band to impress a girl who isn't Eun-gyeol's mother. Eun-gyeol poses as Yoon Dong-jin, a musical genius, in order to try to become a member of Yi-chan's band.

Episodes.Title: Eun Gyeol Becomes Yi Chan's Tutor
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol encounters Se-gyeong in her teens and learns a few things about her life that don't make sense in the future. Meanwhile, Yi-chan meets Chung-ah for the first time, but she doesn't say a word. Yi-chan tries to get away from Eun-gyeol, but Eun-gyeol follows him to the Snail Guesthouse and ends up becoming Yi-chan's math tutor.

Episodes.Title: Se Gyeong Leaves the Country
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol resolves to stop the accident that caused Yi-chan to become deaf and clings to him, vowing to teach him everything he needs to know. He even promises to gift him the band Yi-chan needs. However, the school festival is in one month, and the person Yi-chan is doing this for has left the country and isn't going to return.

Episodes.Title: Se Gyeong Returns
Episodes.Description: Everyone is confused at Se-gyeong's return, especially Eun-gyeol, who sternly warns her to stay away from Yi-chan. However, it doesn't work, and Se-gyeong approaches Yi-chan with different intentions. Meanwhile, Chung-ah can only stand by and watch as she realizes she's lost her chance to tell Yi-chan how she feels.

Episodes.Title: Where Are You Eun Gyeol ?
Episodes.Description: Chung-ah wakes up, realizing she's lying on a hospital bed, with the revelation that Yi-chan carried her there on his back. Later, Yi-chan learns her name from her tag for the first time. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol has been silent for days, causing concern for Yi-chan. Attempting to locate him, Yi-chan hands out flyers and ends up facing trouble with local thugs. Se-gyeong desperately meets with each band member to verify something important.

Episodes.Title: I Found Ha Eun Gyeol
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol wakes up at the house of the Jinsung Family after the accident. He finds out that Chung-ah was the daughter of Chairman Yoon Gun-hyung. Meanwhile, Yi-chan is hospitalized after getting beat up by the local thugs. Se-gyeong tells him that Chung-ah was the one who called for help to save him. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol decides to help Chung-ah learn the sign language.

Episodes.Title: Friendship or Love?
Episodes.Description: Astounded by Eun-gyeol's candid love confession for Se-gyeong, Yi-chan retaliates with a spirited punch. Eun-gyeol's attempts at self-defense lead to Yi-chan having a bleeding nose on both sides. The schoolyard transforms into a battleground as students try to intervene, and the entire situation gains momentum. Se-gyeong (actually Eun-yu) is left in shock by the unexpected confession. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol uncovers a hidden secret about Chung-ah.

Episodes.Title: Let Yourself Twinkle
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol can't hide his feelings for Se-gyeong and ends up kissing her. Chung-ah's stepmother calls Eun-gyeol separately and tells him to quit before he teaches Chung-ah sign language. The members of the band decide to change their band name and theme right before the festival and ask Se-gyeong and Chung-ah for help. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol learns that Master has sent a helper for him.

Episodes.Title: Dangerous Rehearsal
Episodes.Description: As the festival draws near, the boys are intensely focused on fine-tuning their band performance. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol reflects on a pivotal clue related to a potential accident leading to hearing loss. Believing Dong-jin to be the helper that Master mentioned, he pleads with Yi-chan to skip the rehearsal, but his request is dismissed. Meanwhile, Eun-yu grapples with the challenge of uncovering her mother's genuine first love.

Episodes.Title: The Day of Decision
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol successfully cancels the rehearsal and prevents Yi-chan from getting seriously hurt. Chairman Yoon extends the contract with Eun-gyeol and changes the terms and conditions. The day of the festival is finally here, and Se-gyeong has to choose between Eun-gyeol and Yi-chan. Chung-ah decides not to show up at the festival.

Episodes.Title: The Final Festival
Episodes.Description: As the enchanting glow of their festival fades, Eun-gyeol and Eun-yu acknowledge the depth of their feelings, hoping for a lasting connection. Meanwhile, the anticipated disbandment takes an unexpected turn, giving the boys another shot at the stage. The hurdle now is creating their own song, and Yi-chan suggests a gathering for this endeavor while musing on how to persuade Chung-ah to join.

Episodes.Title: Another Time Traveller
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol and Se-gyeong realize that they’re both time travelers. He learns that Se-gyeong also had a mission to accomplish while she was in 1995. Eun-gyeol finds out that Chung-ah has been confined and abused for the past 12 years. Meanwhile, Se-gyeong tells Eun-gyeol that Yi-chan’s accident didn’t happen on the day before the festival and that it hasn’t happened yet.

Episodes.Title: The Hints
Episodes.Description: Eun-yu drops clues about Yi-chan's real hearing loss incident to Eun-gyeol. Knowing that Eun-gyeol tends to shoulder blame for everything, she pledges to support him through this tough time. However, suspicions linger in her mind about the complexity of her connection with Eun-gyeol. Together, they methodically investigate everyone linked to the accident in search of the truth. Meanwhile, Yi-chan assures Eun-gyeol that he won't leave the house for the entire day.

Episodes.Title: Everything You Hoped for and More
Episodes.Description: Yi-chan gets hit by a car and loses his hearing. Master tells Eun-gyeol to go back to his time, but he refuses, determined to catch the guy who hit Yi-chan. Se-gyeong convinces Eun-gyeol to return to 2023, and when he finally does, a completely different life awaits him.

Entries.Title: My Man Is Cupid

Oh Baek-ryeon, an ethereal beauty who committed a great sin in her past life, is doomed to fail every romantic relationship in this lifetime. Just when she is about to give up in love, her fairy Cupid appears in front of her.

Episodes.Title: I Am a Fairy
Episodes.Description: Cheon Sang-hyuk has been trapped on earth for 500 years and has lived as ‘Cupid’, a matchmaker of humans. Oh Baek-ryeon, an ethereal beauty who committed a great sin in her past life, is doomed to fail every romantic relationship in this lifetime. Just when she is about to give up in love, her fairy Cupid appears in front of her.

Episodes.Title: Don't Fall For Me, You'll Get Hurt
Episodes.Description: Baek-ryeon feels a weird sense of familiarity upon encountering Cheon Sang-hyuk. He secretly watches her wondering why she doesn’t have the red thread of fate unlike the other humans. Meanwhile, the night before the snowstorm, a woman gets kidnapped in a public parking lot in Mt. Inwang, and the witnesses of the incident are found dead one by one.

Episodes.Title: The Nobleman of Fate and the Plum Blossom Man
Episodes.Description: Baek-ryeon expects Sang-hyuk, who heroically saved her from her stalker, to be the man of her destiny, but he draws the line that he does not want to be in a relationship with a human. Meanwhile, Sang-hyuk and Jae-hee run into each other at Baek-ryeon’s animal hospital. How were they related to each other in their past lives?

Episodes.Title: When Lotus Flowers Bloom
Episodes.Description: 500 years ago, Cheon Sang-hyuk, a fairy who had no ties to humans, ignored the warnings of Samsin and fell in love with a human girl. As a punishment, his wings got burnt off and he lost his beloved woman. 500 years later, since he well understands the pain of being alone, he empathizes with Baek-ryeon and eagers to help her out. So he starts by asking her what her ideal type is.

Episodes.Title: A Thousand Times, and A Man Of Destiny
Episodes.Description: Sang-hyuk begins to suspect that the culprit in the Inwangsan missing girl case and the 1993 missing high school girl case are the same person. Baek-ryeon is upset because Sanghyuk tries to set her up with a random man while she has a crush on none other than Sanghyuk himself. At last, after climbing Mt. Inwang a thousand times, she gets to meet the man of destiny.

Episodes.Title: Witness And Superman
Episodes.Description: Sang-hyuk and Jae-hee learn that Baek-ryeon was a witness to the Inwangsan disappearance incident. In order to protect Baek-ryeon, Sang-hyuk chases down the criminal like her knight in shining armor. Baek-ryeon is happy when Sang-hyuk protects her like Superman and doesn't get hurt even after the intense physical fight, and she gets very curious about his true identity.

Episodes.Title: What The Criminal Knows
Episodes.Description: Sang-hyuk, who stays the night at Baek-ryeon's house, dreams of Jeong-ah, and in the dream, Baek-ryeon is warned not to let go of the hand of the man of destiny. In real life, Baekryeon is put in danger as the criminal constantly keeps his eye on her while the number of murder victims increases.

Episodes.Title: Loving Someone
Episodes.Description: The disappearance of a high school girl in 1993 still remains unsolved as Sang-hyuk, who was in charge of the case, has disappeared from the human world for decades. Sang-hyuk is convinced that the culprit of the missing high school girl case and the culprit of the Inwang Mountain missing woman case are the same person, and he actively participates in the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Things That Do Not Change Even If You Are Reincarnated
Episodes.Description: Baek-ryeon goes to find the street she saw in her dream. Although it is her first time to see that street, she feels strangely familiar and her heart starts to ache. The more Sang-hyuk learns about his feelings for Baek-ryeon, the more he becomes afraid of approaching her. He doesn't believe he deserves her.

Episodes.Title: My Man Is...?
Episodes.Description: Sang-hyuk remembers Baek-ryeon saying she was an angel when she was drunk, and he secretly hopes that she actually is an angel. Meanwhile, Go Eun-seo, a missing woman from Mt. Inwang, calls Baek-ryeon and tells her that she is alive and asks her to come. Baekryeon goes alone to the address where Eun-seo is.

Episodes.Title: The Power To Face Fate… Courage
Episodes.Description: Baek-ryeon sees her past life during her surgery, and is confused because the angel in her past life resembles Sang-hyuk. Meanwhile, Jae-hee begins to have doubts about Sang-hyuk's identity, and the legal hypnotist Cheong-il gives Sang-hyuk Baekryeon's unofficial hypnosis records.

Episodes.Title: The Reason You Are In Front Of Me Now
Episodes.Description: Jae-hee informs Baek-ryeon that Sang-hyuk is not human, and Baek-ryun suddenly remembers Sang-hyuk's missing hand. Meanwhile, she realizes that she forgot to climb the mountain one last time so she goes to Inwang mountain to complete her mission. Jae-hee and Sang-hyuk also head there to find her.

Episodes.Title: Cause And Effect
Episodes.Description: The police arrest Kim Myeong-sik as the prime suspect who finally confesses that he killed Go Eun-seo. He claims that there will be no more victims since he will be locked up. Meanwhile, Jeong-ah's parents come to Baekryeon's animal hospital, and Baekryun suddenly sheds tears as she hears the story of their daughter's disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Just before his final “metamorphosis”, Sang-hyuk finds out who Baek-ryeon is and feels very confused. After hearing that once he enters the transformation phase, nobody can tell when he will come out, Baek-ryeon fears that Sang-hyuk will disappear forever. Jae-hee happens to see a portrait of Sang-hyuk and So-hee, and he visits Sang-hyuk to ask who the woman in the painting is.

Episodes.Title: Last Witness
Episodes.Description: When Kim Myeong-sik, whom everyone identified as the culprit, gets murdered, the case becomes even more mysterious. Baek-ryeon hears the criminal's voice in her dream, which reminds her of some voice she heard in real life recently. Meanwhile, Sang-hyuk conducts a large-scale search of the Jongseo-gu area with several clues.

Episodes.Title: My Man Is
Episodes.Description: Baek-ryeon now faces the very same ill fate as she had in her past life. 500 years ago, her life was spared thanks to Sang-hyuk who turned her fate around but as a punishment for intruding in the divine business, he has been bound to go through several metamorphosis for 5 centuries. Meanwhile, Baek-ryun confronts a huge crisis due to Song Young-cheol's scheme.

Entries.Title: True to Love
Entries.Description: Bo-ra, aka dating coach Deborah, believes that a strategy is necessary in a relationship. In order to lead the relationship with her boyfriend Ju-wan to a happy ending, Bo-ra strategically plans to get a proposal from him. However, her plan is ruined by Su-hyeok who is also determined to propose to his girlfriend, Yu-ri.

Episodes.Title: Something Small and Sparkly
Episodes.Description: Bo-ra, aka dating coach Deborah, believes that a strategy is necessary in a relationship. In order to lead the relationship with her boyfriend Ju-wan to a happy ending, Bo-ra strategically plans to get a proposal from him. However, her plan is ruined by Su-hyeok who is also determined to propose to his girlfriend, Yu-ri.

Episodes.Title: Sad Ending
Episodes.Description: Deborah, it is all your fault! Su-hyeok blames Deborah for his breakup with Yu-ri, and they go head-to-head at their first work meeting together. But the tension between them has unexpected outcomes...

Episodes.Title: The End of a Pathetic Relationship
Episodes.Description: Bo-ra still denies Ju-wan is cheating on her, even after she witnesses it herself. She rationalizes his behavior and hopes he will sort out the situation. But things don't go as planned. Bo-ra overhears the truth Ju-wan has been hiding and it all leads to a devastating consequence.

Episodes.Title: Crazier Than Joker
Episodes.Description: Before overcoming her breakup, Bo-ra hides her pain behind a smile and attends a major party for singles. At an important moment, drunk Bo-ra is invited to the stage, and with the microphone in her hands, she goes crazy. Knowing the pain behind her smile, the one person ready to jump on stage to save her is Su-hyeok.

Episodes.Title: A Cold Is Incurable
Episodes.Description: Just when Bo-ra thinks everyone has forgotten about her incident, her column is released and she is humiliated once again. Things get worse when she runs into Ju-wan, and out of all people, Su-hyeok witnesses yet another embarassing moment. Su-hyeok unexpectedly comforts her and Bo-ra musters up the courage just one last time.

Episodes.Title: I Will Survive in This Beautiful Breeze
Episodes.Description: Bo-ra finally decides to gather herself, being free from Ju-wan for good. While sharing the good news, Bo-ra also says goodbye to Su-hyeok. Just when Su-hyeok thought he won't see her again, Bo-ra reaches out to him once again.

Episodes.Title: Shall We?
Episodes.Description: After Bo-ra finalizes her dating book contract, she joins the dinner with the staff of the publishing company. Just when Su-hyeok thought he has seen all the embarrassing moments he can of Bo-ra... She strikes again.

Episodes.Title: Rewrite the Ending of This Story
Episodes.Description: Su-hyeok is invited to Bo-ra’s housewarming party. As the two of them start a plan to win back Ju-wan’s heart, they get closer. And a sudden silence leads them into an unexpected happening.

Episodes.Title: Things We Say After A Kiss
Episodes.Description: After the unexpected kiss, both Bo-ra and Su-hyeok are confused. They agree it was a simple mistake and decide to forget about it. Yet, a little disappointed Bo-ra makes a mistake again and Su-hyeok is determined to not let her off this time. Before they clear the air, they run into each other in an unexpected place.

Episodes.Title: Catfish Makes Way, Sardine Makes a Move
Episodes.Description: Women's Secret Party turns into a crazy couples’ party. Bo-ra and Su-hyeok reconcile their relationship by defining each other as Mulder/Scully and DiCaprio/Kate Winslet. At night, Bo-ra receives a surprising message. If a catfish makes way, is the sardine going to make a move?

Episodes.Title: Can't Wait for Winter to Come
Episodes.Description: The presence of the tough catfish Yu-ri shakes Su-hyeok. Bo-ra tries to stop Su-hyeok when he is about to leave for Yu-ri. Bo-ra criticizes Yu-ri for being clingy but soon realizes she does not have the right to do so. And finally, Bo-ra decides to face her disguised relationship with Ju-wan.

Episodes.Title: Like a Scene From a Drama
Episodes.Description: Bo-ra and Su-hyeok walk a very thin line on their exciting first date, and Bo-ra is more confused about her relationship with him. Bo-ra accompanies Su-hyeok to Yu-ri’s wedding as his girlfriend, and she recalls a memory during the ceremony. The memory makes Bo-ra anticipate that something like a scene from a drama could happen to her as well.

Episodes.Title: It's All About Timing, Take Courage First
Episodes.Description: With Su-hyeok’s support, Bo-ra returns to the radio. She expresses her feelings towards Su-hyeok on the radio, and Su-hyeok runs to Bo-ra to show her how he feels about her too. But Su-hyeok sees Ju-wan arrive before him and the bad timing makes them misunderstand each other.

Episodes.Title: True to Love
Episodes.Description: Dating someone at work is the worst. Bo-ra and Su-hyeok explode with anger during a meeting, and the publishing of Bo-ra's dating book ends up in failure. At night, Bo-ra storms out when Su-hyeok calls her as she realizes it is time to write the ending of their story once and for all.

Episodes.Description: While moping over her career downfall, Sam-dal awkwardly encounters Jo Yong-pil. She later runs into him again — where she must come to his rescue.

Episodes.Description: As Yong-pil shows concern for Sam-dal, she confronts him about his insistence. When a reporter shows up to Sam-dal's town, her friends go to bat for her.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Up, With Love
Episodes.Description: Sang-do confronts Yong-pil about their shared feelings for Sam-dal. Sam-dal's mother begins to suspect something is happening between Sam-dal and Yong-pil.

Episodes.Description: Go Mi-ja experiences a frightening moment during a dive amid lingering health problems. After much encouragement, Sam-dal enters a photo competition.

Episodes.Title: The Story of the Two Mi-jas
Episodes.Description: As Mi-ja's condition remains dire, Sam-dal learns she's been unaware about her mother's health — and that Yong-pil's been more present than she'd known.

Episodes.Title: The Variables We Couldn't Predict
Episodes.Description: After a drunken night, Sam-dal agonizes over a tender moment with Yong-pil. But they soon are forced to take a trip around Jeju for the photo contest.

Episodes.Title: What Doesn't Kill You Makes You Stronger
Episodes.Description: A man from Jo Jin-dal's past angers her family with an ill-advised announcement. Sam-dal continues to agonize over her feelings toward Yong-pil.

Episodes.Title: Welcome Home
Episodes.Description: Sam-dal worries about her mother's perception as her relationship with Yong-pil's grows. After uploading a video of Sam-dal, Eun-joo comes to Samdal-ri.

Episodes.Title: That Damn One-sided Love
Episodes.Description: Just as Yong-pil and Sam-dal get closer, his father harshly rebukes them. Amid the tension, Mi-ja finally stands up for herself — and the past.

Episodes.Title: When Your Tears Dry Out
Episodes.Description: After becoming official, Sam-dal and Yong-pil go off on a shoot — but they're joined by guests. Sam-dal later attempts to win over Yong-pil's father.

Episodes.Title: It Takes a Village to Raise a Dragon
Episodes.Description: Eun-joo plants a story about Sam-dal, complicating her role in the photo contest. But Sam-dal's community bands together to aid in her exhibition.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Samdal-ri
Episodes.Description: As Eun-joo's lies catch up to her, Sam-dal hosts her exhibition. She later finds out about Yong-pil's secret dream — and his hesitation about pursuing it.
